12001.Name: Royal Decree
12001.Info: Play a Gold unit from your deck and Boost it by 2.
12001.Flavor: We, Foltest, by divine right King of Temeria, Prince of Sodden, Senior Protector of Brugge, etcetera, etcetera, do hereby decree the following…
12001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Gold unit from your deck and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2.

12002.Name: Geralt: Igni
12002.Info: Deploy: Destroy the Highest units on an enemy row if that row has a total of 25 points or more.
12002.Flavor: A twist of a witcher's fingers can light a lamp… or incinerate a foe.
12002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy the Highest units on an enemy row if that row has a total of 25 points or more.

12003.Name: Dandelion: Poet
12003.Info: Deploy: Draw 1 card, then play 1 card.
12003.Flavor: The quill is mightier than the sword.

12004.Name: Geralt of Rivia
12004.Flavor: If that's what it takes to save the world, it's better to let that world die.

12005.Name: Ciri: Dash
12005.Info: Whenever this unit enters the graveyard, return it to your deck and Strengthen it by 3.
12005.Flavor: Know when fairy tales cease to be tales? When people start believing them.
12005.EnhancedInfo: Whenever this unit enters the graveyard, return it to your deck and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3.

12006.Name: Saesenthessis: Blaze
12006.Info: Deploy: Banish your hand and draw that many cards.
12006.Flavor: I inherited my father's ability to assume other forms - well, one other form, in my case.
12006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Banish</color> your hand and <color=mycolor>draw</color> that many cards.

12007.Name: Triss Merigold
12007.Flavor: I can take care of myself. Trust me.

12008.Name: Villentretenmerth
12008.Info:
After 3 turns, on turn start, destroy the Highest units, excluding self.
3 Armor.
12008.Flavor: Also calls himself Borkh Three Jackdaws… he's not the best at names.
12008.EnhancedInfo:
After 3 turns, on turn start, destroy the Highest units, excluding self.
3 Armor.

12009.Name: Ale of the Ancestors
12009.Info:
Deploy: Apply Golden Froth to the row.
When moved, repeat its ability, then deal 4 Damage to self.
12009.Flavor: Boros, the legendary founder of Clan Fuchs, died after overindulging in this beverage - he passed out while reaching for his golden ring, which had fallen into a brook.
12009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Apply Golden Froth to the row.
When moved, repeat its ability, then deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to self.

12010.Name: Yennefer: Conjurer
12010.Info: On turn end, deal 1 Damage to the Highest enemies.
12010.Flavor: A good sorceress must know when to conjure ice… and when to conjure fire.
12010.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest enemies.

12011.Name: Dandelion: Vainglory
12011.Info: Deploy: For every Geralt, Yennefer, Triss and Zoltan Gold card in your starting deck, Boost self by 3.
12011.Flavor: Dandelion told me all about your adventures. How he'd ready you for battle with his songs, how he tamed the kayran by playin' his lute...
12011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: For every Geralt, Yennefer, Triss and Zoltan Gold card in your starting deck, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3.

12012.Name: Avallac'h
12012.Info: Deploy, Truce: Each player draws 2 cards.

12013.Name: Lambert: Swordmaster
12013.Info: Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to all copies of an enemy.
12013.Flavor: Go teach your grandma to suck eggs.
12013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all copies of an enemy.

12014.Name: Triss: Butterflies
12014.Info: On turn end, Boost the Lowest allies by 1.
12014.Flavor: Cap'n… our arrows, they've… they've got wings!
12014.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Lowest allies by 1.

12015.Name: Zoltan: Scoundrel
12015.Info:
Deploy: Spawn a Duda: Agitator, or Duda: Campanion. 
(Duda: Agitator; 1 Strength. Deal 2 Damage to 2 units on each side)
(Duda: Companion; 1 Strength. Boost 2 units on each side by 2)
12015.Flavor: Apologies. My exotic pet's a clever birdie, but a wee bit lewd. Paid ten thalers for the beaute.
12015.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Duda: Agitator, or Duda: Campanion. 
(Duda: Agitator; 1 Strength. Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 2 units on each side)
(Duda: Companion; 1 Strength. <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 2 units on each side by 2)

12016.Name: Eskel: Pathfinder
12016.Info: Deploy: Destroy a Bronze or Silver enemy that is not Boosted.
12016.Flavor: Heard you panting from three miles away. Just didn't wanna give up that vantage point.
12016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy a Bronze or Silver enemy that is not Boosted.

12017.Name: Geralt: Professional
12017.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to an enemy.
If it's a Monster unit, destroy it instead.
12017.Flavor: I accepted a job once, did it. Asked to choose my reward, I invoked the Law of Surprise.
12017.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If it's a Monster unit, destroy it instead.

12018.Name: Ihuarraquax
12018.Info:
Deploy: Deal 5 Damage to self.
The first time this unit's current Power is equal to its base Power, on turn end, deal 7 Damage to 3 random enemies.
12018.Flavor: Inconceivable. Impossible, Ciri thought, returning to her senses. Unicorns don't exist, not any more, not in this world. Unicorns are extinct.
12018.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to self.
The first time this unit's current <color=mycolor>Power</color> is equal to its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>, on turn end, deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 3 random enemies.

12019.Name: Ciri
12019.Info: Whenever you lose a round, return this unit to your hand.
12019.Flavor: I go wherever I please, whenever I please.
12019.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you lose a round, return this unit to your hand.

12020.Name: Gaunter O'Dimm
12020.Info:
Deploy, Gamble with Gaunter: Guess whether the Power of the random card he picked is lower, equal or higher than 6.
If guessed, you can play that card.
12020.Flavor: He always grants exactly what you wish for. That's the problem.
12020.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, Gamble with Gaunter: Guess whether the <color=mycolor>Power</color> of the random card he picked is lower, equal or higher than 6.
If guessed, you can <color=mycolor>play</color> that card.

12021.Name: Geralt: Aard
12021.Info: Deploy: Deal 3 Damage to 3 enemies and move them to the row above.
12021.Flavor: A blast of concentrated energy that pummels everything in its path. Great for when you forget your keys.
12021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 3 enemies and move them to the row above.

12022.Name: Regis: Higher Vampire
12022.Info:
Deploy: Look at the top 3 Bronze units from your opponent's deck.
Consume 1, then Boost self by its base Power.
12022.Flavor: He becomes invisible at will. His glance hypnotizes into a deep sleep. He then drinks his fill, turns into a bat and flies off. Altogether uncouth.
12022.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at the top 3 Bronze units from your opponent's deck.
Consume 1, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

12023.Name: Vesemir: Mentor
12023.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Alchemy card from your deck.
12023.Flavor: Killing monsters is not something to be taken lightly. Ciri must understand that if she's to become one of us.
12023.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Alchemy card from your deck.

12024.Name: Yennefer
12024.Info:
Deploy: Spawn Unicorn or Chironex.
(Unicorn; 1 Strength. Boost all other units by 2)
(Chironex; 4 Strength. Deal 2 Damage to all other units)
12024.Flavor: Magic is Chaos, Art and Science. It is a curse, a blessing and a progression.
12024.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Unicorn or Chironex.
(Unicorn; 1 Strength. <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all other units by 2)
(Chironex; 4 Strength. Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all other units)

12025.Name: Geralt: Yrden
12025.Info: Deploy: Reset all units on a row and remove their statuses.
12025.Flavor: He lay down next to Adda's mummified remains, drawing the Yrden Sign on the inner side of her sarcophagus' lid.
12025.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> all units on a row and remove their statuses.

12026.Name: Triss: Telekinesis
12026.Info: Deploy: Create a Bronze special card from either player's starting deck.
12026.Flavor: Bindings won't suffice. Nor will a gag render her any less dangerous. No, dimeritium is the only solution.
12026.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze special card from either player's starting deck.

12027.Name: Aguara
12027.Info: Deploy, Choose Two: Boost the Lowest ally by 5; Boost a random loyal unit in your hand by 5; Deal 5 Damage to the Highest enemy; Charm a random enemy Elf with 5 Power or less.
12027.Flavor: Smarten up right now, or it's off to an aguara with you!
12027.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, Choose Two: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Lowest ally by 5; <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random <color=mycolor>loyal</color> unit in your hand by 5; Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest enemy; <color=mycolor>Charm</color> a random enemy Elf with 5 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

12028.Name: Phoenix
12028.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver Draconid.
12028.Flavor: What came first, the phoenix or the egg?

12029.Name: Avallac'h: Sage
12029.Info: Deploy: Spawn a copy of a random Gold or Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck.
12029.Flavor: Amongst the free elves were a handful of Aen Saevherne, or Sages. They were an enigma, bordering on a legend.
12029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a copy of a random Gold or Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck.

12030.Name: Aguara: True Form
12030.Info: Deploy: Create a Bronze or Silver Spell.
12030.Flavor: Ever heard of an anterion? Think of it as the opposite of a lycanthrope: a beast which can take on human form.

12031.Name: Regis
12031.Info: Deploy: Drain all Boosts from a unit.
12031.Flavor: Some consider me a monster. A blood-crazed, savage monster.
12031.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Drain all Boosts from a unit.

12032.Name: Ciri: Nova
12032.Info: Deploy: If you have exactly 2 copies of each Bronze card in your starting deck, set the base Power of this card to 22.
12032.Flavor: Zireael possesses a great power she cannot control. She is a danger - to herself, to others. Until she learns to control it, she should remain isolated.
12032.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: If you have exactly 2 copies of each Bronze card in your starting deck, set the base <color=mycolor>Power</color> of this card to 22.

12033.Name: Korathi Heatwave
12033.Info: Apply a Hazard to each enemy row that deals 2 Damage to the Lowest unit on turn start.
12033.Flavor: Vicovaro scholars have determined that, in the absence of imperial aid, drought-stricken provinces lose half their population, two-thirds of their livestock and all their will to rebel.
12033.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to each enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Lowest unit on turn start.

12034.Name: Ragh Nar Roog
12034.Info: Apply a Hazard to each enemy row that deals 2 Damage to the Highest unit on turn start.
12034.Flavor: In the Final Age, Hemdall will come forth to face the evil issuing from the land of Morhogg – the legions of wraiths, demons and specters of Chaos.
12034.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to each enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest unit on turn start.

12036.Name: Vigo's Muzzle
12036.Info: Charm a Bronze or Silver enemy with 8 Power or less.
12036.Flavor: Never has there been a beast Fringilla Vigo could not tame.
12036.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Charm</color> a Bronze or Silver enemy with 8 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

12037.Name: Wolfsbane
12037.Info: After 3 turns in the graveyard, on turn end, deal 6 Damage to the Highest enemy and Boost the Lowest ally by 6.
12037.Flavor: Also known as 'the queen of poisons,' wolfsbane is used in many witcher Potions and alchemic brews.
12037.EnhancedInfo: After 3 turns in the graveyard, on turn end, deal 6 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest enemy and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Lowest ally by 6.

12038.Name: Hanmarvyn's Blue Dream
12038.Info: Spawn a copy of a non-Leader Gold unit from your opponent's graveyard and Boost it by 2.
12038.Flavor: This spell lets you see the last moments of a dead man's life… if you can survive its casting.
12038.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a copy of a non-Leader Gold unit from your opponent's graveyard and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2.

12039.Name: Uma's Curse
12039.Flavor: I give you three solid leads, trails as fresh as morning dew, the aid of my spies and my court sorceress. Yet in my daughter's stead, you bring me this… monstrosity?

12040.Name: Trial of the Grasses
12040.Info:
Deal 10 Damage to a unit, unless it's a Witcher.
If it survives, Boost it to 25 Power.
12040.Flavor: Imagine a lump of clay. In order to shape it, you must first moisten it or it will crumble. The Trial's initial part does just that. It opens the body to change, so to speak. Only then can the mutagens produce a witcher.
12040.EnhancedInfo:
Deal 10 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a unit, unless it's a Witcher.
If it survives, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it to 25 <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

12041.Name: Shupe's Bizarre Adventure
12041.Info: If your starting deck has no duplicates, send Shupe on an adventure.
12041.EnhancedInfo: If your starting deck has no duplicates, send Shupe on an adventure.

12042.Name: Sihil
12042.Info: Choose One: Deal 3 Damage to all enemies with odd Power; or Deal 3 Damage to all enemies with even Power; or Play a random Bronze or Silver unit from your deck.
12042.Flavor: What's written on this blade? That a curse? No. An insult.
12042.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies with odd <color=mycolor>Power</color>; or Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies with even <color=mycolor>Power</color>; or <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze or Silver unit from your deck.

13001.Name: Roach
13001.Info: Whenever a loyal Gold unit is played on your side of the board, Summon this unit on a random row.
13001.Flavor: Geralt, we gotta have a man–to–horse talk. No offense, but your riding skills? They leave a bit to be desired, buddy.
13001.EnhancedInfo: Whenever a <color=mycolor>loyal</color> Gold unit is played on your side of the board, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> this unit on a random row.

13002.Name: Francis Bedlam
13002.Info: Deploy: If losing, Strengthen self up to a maximum of 15 until scores are tied.
13002.Flavor: I might just discover I look great without ears… or hands. Apparently the King of Beggars accepts both as partial payment.
13002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: If losing, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self up to a maximum of 15 until scores are tied.

13003.Name: Sarah
13003.Info: Deploy: Swap a card for one of the same color.
13003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Swap</color> a card for one of the same color.

13004.Name: Iris' Companions
13004.Info: Deploy: Move a card from your deck to your hand, then Discard a random card.
13004.Flavor: We'd rather keep our names to ourselves. Think of us as… friends of the house.
13004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move a card from your deck to your hand, then <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a random card.

13005.Name: Germain Piquant
13005.Info:
Deploy: Spawn 2 Cows on each side of this unit.
(Cow; 1 Strength)
13005.Flavor: The hero Toussaint needs, but not the one it deserves.
13005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 2 Cows on each side of this unit.
(Cow; 1 Strength)

13006.Name: Nivellen
13006.Info: Deploy: Move all units on a row to random rows.
13006.Flavor: Lost? Well, go be lost somewhere else. Somewhere not on my property, that is. Point your left ear to the sun and keep walking, you'll hit the road soon enough. Well? What're you waiting for?
13006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move all units on a row to random rows.

13007.Name: Stregobor
13007.Info:
Single-Use.
Deploy, Truce: Each player draws a unit and sets its Power to 1.
13007.Flavor: The witcher had met thieves that looked like town councilors, town councilors that looked like beggars and kings that looked like thieves. Stregobor, though, always looked exactly like the commonly accepted imagining of what a mage should look like.
13007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: Each player draws a unit and sets its <color=mycolor>Power</color> to 1.

13008.Name: Johnny
13008.Info: Deploy: Discard a card, then add a copy of a card of the same color from your opponent's starting deck in your hand.
13008.Flavor: Life without savoring the sound of surreptitious shananacking is like licking snails through a cloth.
13008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a card, then add a copy of a card of the same color from your opponent's starting deck in your hand.

13009.Name: Cyprian Wiley
13009.Flavor: Ever since his father died, he's become a real whoreson.

13010.Name: Ocvist
13010.Info:
Single-Use.
After 4 turns, on turn start, deal 1 Damage to all enemies, then return to your hand.
13010.Flavor: The Master of Quartz Mountain, the Destroyer, Trajan's Slayer. In his free time, he likes long walks and candlelight dinners.
13010.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
After 4 turns, on turn start, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies, then return to your hand.

13011.Name: Carlo Varese
13011.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage for each card in your hand, to an enemy.
13011.Flavor: Everyone wantin' to trade in Novigrad's got a clear choice - agree terms with Cleaver or kiss their knees farewell.
13011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> for each card in your hand, to an enemy.

13012.Name: Myrgtabrakke
13012.Info: Deploy: Damage units by 3, 2 and then 1.
13012.Flavor: Never get between a mother dragon and her young.

13013.Name: Vesemir
13013.Info: Deploy: Summon Eskel and Lambert on this row.
13013.Flavor: If you're to be hanged, ask for water. Anything can happen before they fetch it.
13013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Eskel and Lambert on this row.

13014.Name: Eskel
13014.Info: Deploy: Summon Vesemir and Lambert on this row.
13014.Flavor: I'm a simple witcher, Wolf. Don't fight dragons, don't fraternize with kings and don't sleep with sorceresses…
13014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Vesemir and Lambert on this row.

13015.Name: Olgierd von Everec
13015.Info: On turn start, resurrect itself and Weaken itself by half.
13015.Flavor: At least you now know I don't easily lose my head.
13015.EnhancedInfo: On turn start, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> itself and Weaken itself by half.

13016.Name: Operator
13016.Info: Deploy, Single-Use, Truce: Add a default copy of a Bronze unit in your hand to both hands.
13016.Flavor: As time and space collapse before us, they expand behind us. In that way one moves forward through both.
13016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: Add a default copy of a Bronze unit in your hand to both hands.

13017.Name: Lambert
13017.Info: Deploy: Summon Eskel and Vesemir on this row.
13017.Flavor: Now that's the kind of negotiating I understand.
13017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Eskel and Vesemir on this row.

13018.Name: Vaedermakar
13018.Info: Deploy: Spawn Biting Frost, Impenetrable Fog or Alzur's Thunder.
13018.Flavor: Vaedermakar druids control the elements. They soothe storms into silence, muster destructive hail, summon lightning to turn foes into ash. So I advise you well… treat them with utmost respect.
13018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Biting Frost, Impenetrable Fog or Alzur's Thunder.

13019.Name: Iris von Everec
13019.Info:
Spying.
Deathwish: Boost 5 random units on the opposite side by 5.
13019.Flavor: I remember so little… Yet when I think of my rose, I begin to recall what was.
13019.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 5 random units on the opposite side by 5.

13020.Name: Dorregaray of Vole
13020.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Savage Bear, Wyvern, Barbegazi or Drowner.
13020.Flavor: Like the witchers, Dorregaray is a monster aficionado, though he's developed his own classification system. Instead of dividing them into necrophages, ogroids and the like, he just thinks they're all wonderful.
13020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Savage Bear, Wyvern, Barbegazi or Drowner.

13021.Name: Dudu
13021.Info: Deploy: Choose an enemy and copy its Power.
13021.Flavor: A mimic, among the many other names for his sort: changelings, doublings, vexlings… or dopplers.
13021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose an enemy and copy its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

13022.Name: Prize-Winning Cow
13022.Info:
Deathwish: Spawn a Chort on a random row.
(Chort; 14 Strength)
13022.EnhancedInfo:
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Chort on a random row.
(Chort; 14 Strength)

13023.Name: Black Blood
13023.Info: Choose One: Create a Bronze Necrophage or Vampire and Boost it by 2; or Destroy a Bronze or Silver Necrophage or Vampire.
13023.Flavor: Vampires all agree: use of this potion is bad sportsmanship.
13023.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze Necrophage or Vampire and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2; or Destroy a Bronze or Silver Necrophage or Vampire.

13024.Name: Alzur's Double–Cross
13024.Info: Boost the Highest Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and play it.
13024.Flavor: A few of Alzur's monstrous creations roam the world still. Not least among them the horrid viy, who massacred its mage-creator and destroyed half of Maribor before fleeing into Riverdell's gloomy woodland.
13024.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Highest Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and <color=mycolor>play</color> it.

13025.Name: Artefact Compression
13025.Info:
Transform a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine.
(Jade Figurine; 2 Strength)
13025.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Transform</color> a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine.
(Jade Figurine; 2 Strength)

13026.Name: Bekker's Dark Mirror
13026.Info: Transfer up to 11 Power between the Highest and Lowest unit.
13026.Flavor: Gaze long into the abyss, and the abyss will gaze back into you.
13026.EnhancedInfo: Transfer up to 11 <color=mycolor>Power</color> between the Highest and Lowest unit.

13027.Name: Commander's Horn
13027.Flavor: Plus one to morale, minus one to hearing.

13028.Name: Decoy
13028.Info: Return a Bronze or Silver ally to your hand, Boost it by 3 and play it.
13028.Flavor: When you run out of peasants, decoys also make decent arrow fodder.
13028.EnhancedInfo: Return a Bronze or Silver ally to your hand, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 3 and <color=mycolor>play</color> it.

13029.Name: Dimeritium Bomb
13029.Info: Reset all Boosted units on a row.
13029.Flavor: An important part of every Witch Hunter's kit. In one muted flash, it turns the most powerful sorcerer into pork jelly ripe for cutting.
13029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> all Boosted units on a row.

13030.Name: Manticore Venom
13030.Flavor: Kills quicker than you can recite the Emperor of Nilfgaard's title in full.

13031.Name: Marching Orders
13031.Info: Boost the Lowest Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and play it.
13031.Flavor: We are but pawns in a game played by old men, sent to fight and die on their senile whims…
13031.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Lowest Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and <color=mycolor>play</color> it.

13032.Name: Merigold's Hailstorm
13032.Info: Halve the Power of all Bronze and Silver units on a row.
13032.Flavor: The sky dimmed of a sudden, and clouds amassed over the town. It grew fiendishly dark, and a cold gust swept in. Oh my, gasped Yennefer. We're about to make quite the mess, I think.
13032.EnhancedInfo: Halve the <color=mycolor>Power</color> of all Bronze and Silver units on a row.

13033.Name: Necromancy
13033.Info: Banish a Bronze or Silver unit from either graveyard, then Boost an ally by its Power.
13033.Flavor: We have ways of making you talk… alive or dead.
13033.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Banish</color> a Bronze or Silver unit from either graveyard, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> an ally by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

13034.Name: Scorch
13034.Flavor: Geralt took one step back. He'd seen men hit by Scorch before. Or more accurately, seen what remained of them afterwards.

13035.Name: Skellige Storm
13035.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 2, 1 and 1 Damage to the leftmost units on the row on turn start.
13035.Flavor: This ain't no normal storm. This here's the wrath of the gods.
13035.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 2, 1 and 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the leftmost units on the row on turn start.

13036.Name: Summoning Circle
13036.Info: Spawn a default copy of the last Bronze or Silver non-Agent unit placed on the board.
13036.Flavor: There exist a great many realities outside our own… With the right knowledge, one can contact them and summon beings beyond human fathoming.
13036.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a default copy of the last Bronze or Silver non-Agent unit placed on the board.

13037.Name: The Last Wish
13037.Info:
Look at the top 2 cards from your deck.
Play 1 and shuffle the other back.
13037.Flavor: A djinn, good sirs, fulfills but three wishes. Thus freed, it flees to dimensions unknown.
13037.EnhancedInfo:
Look at the top 2 cards from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Play</color> 1 and shuffle the other back.

13038.Name: White Frost
13038.Info:
Apply Biting Frost to a row and the one above it.
(Every turn, on turn start, Damage the Lowest unit on the row by 2).
13038.Flavor: Behold Tedd Deireadh, the Final Age. The world destroyed by the White Frost.
13038.EnhancedInfo:
Apply Biting Frost to a row and the one above it.
(Every turn, on turn start, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> the Lowest unit on the row by 2).

13039.Name: Tainted Ale
13039.Info: Deal 6 Damage to the Highest enemy on each row.
13039.Flavor: That beer supposed to be green…?
13039.EnhancedInfo: Deal 6 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest enemy on each row.

13040.Name: Mandrake
13040.Info: Choose One: Heal a unit and Strengthen it by 6; or Reset a unit and Weaken it by 6.
13040.Flavor: There you all stand! With wonderment awake, doubting the plan and high-discovery. Some, as if grappled by the fell mandrake, some, by the black dog's devilry.
13040.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Heal a unit and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 6; or <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit and Weaken it by 6.

13041.Name: Bekker's Rockslide
13041.Info: Deal 2 Damage to up to 10 random enemies.
13041.Flavor: All it takes is one pebble and we're all done for.
13041.EnhancedInfo: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to up to 10 random enemies.

13042.Name: Glorious Hunt
13042.Info:
If losing, Spawn an Imperial Manticore.
If winning, Spawn Manticore Venom.
(Imperial Manticore; 13 Strength)
(Manticore Venom: Damage a unit by 13)
13042.Flavor: By the gods' gonads, witcher, why'd you bring me this filth?! I want that beast's head! - that was a ploughin' figure of ploughin' speech!
13042.EnhancedInfo:
If losing, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> an Imperial Manticore.
If winning, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Manticore Venom.
(Imperial Manticore; 13 Strength)
(Manticore Venom: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> a unit by 13)

13043.Name: Dragon's Dream
13043.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that will explode and deal 4 Damage to all units when next special card is played.
13043.Flavor: In Zerrikania, dragon worship dominates every aspect of daily life. Thus it comes as no surprise they name weapons in their honor.
13043.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that will explode and deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units when next special card is played.

13044.Name: Garrison
13044.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck and Boost it by 2.
13044.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2.

14001.Name: Scout
14001.Info: Look at 2 random Bronze units in your deck, then play 1.
14001.Flavor: If our scouts don't come back, we turn around. The yokels claim these woods are full o' squirrels - and I don't mean the nut-gatherin' kind.
14001.EnhancedInfo: Look at 2 random Bronze units in your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

14002.Name: Adrenaline Rush
14002.Flavor: The beast rushed at them wildly, with fury in its eyes, immune to pain and any strikes the defenders could land. Nothing stood to stop it…

14003.Name: Alzur's Thunder
14003.Flavor: We stand not the slightest chance of incanting a spell so complex as Alzur's Thunder. It is claimed Alzur had a voice like a hunting horn and the diction of a master orator.

14004.Name: Arachas Venom
14004.Flavor: If substance makes contact with eyes, rinse immediately with cold water, then commence drawing up will.

14005.Name: Biting Frost
14005.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 2 Damage to the Lowest unit on turn start.
14005.Flavor: Best thing about frost? Bodies of the fallen don't rot so quickly.
14005.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Lowest unit on turn start.

14006.Name: Bloodcurdling Roar
14006.Info:
Destroy an ally, then Spawn a Bear.
(Bear; 11 Strength)
14006.EnhancedInfo:
Destroy an ally, then <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bear.
(Bear; 11 Strength)

14007.Name: Dimeritium Shackles
14007.Info:
Toggle a unit's Lock status.
If an enemy, deal 5 Damage to it.
14007.Flavor: The mage's arms were twisted and bound behind his back. The Redanians gave the fetters a good shake. Terranova cried out, lurched, bent backwards, bowed forward, then retched and groaned. It was clear of what his manacles were made.
14007.EnhancedInfo:
Toggle a unit's <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status.
If an enemy, deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to it.

14008.Name: Epidemic
14008.Flavor: Epidemics respect no persons, no borders.

14009.Name: First Light
14009.Info:
Spawn Clear Skies or Rally. 
(Clear skies: Boost all Damaged allies under Hazards by 2 and clear all Hazards from your side)
(Rally: Play a random Bronze unit from your deck)
14009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Clear Skies or Rally. 
(Clear skies: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Damaged allies under Hazards by 2 and clear all Hazards from your side)
(Rally: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze unit from your deck)

14010.Name: Petri's Philter
14010.Info: Boost up to 6 random allies by 2.
14010.Flavor: A mage responsible for dozens of brilliant inventions. The mind of a generation. Commonly referred to around the Continent as that bloke with the dish.

14011.Name: Impenetrable Fog
14011.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 2 Damage to the Highest unit on turn start.
14011.Flavor: A good commander's dream… and a bad one's horror.
14011.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest unit on turn start.

14012.Name: Lacerate
14012.Info: Damage all units on a row by 3.
14012.Flavor: A sight more horrid you've never seen… The poor soul lay shredded as the beast lapped up its blood from the ground all around.
14012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on a row by 3.

14013.Name: Mardroeme
14013.Info: Choose One: Reset a unit and Strengthen it by 3; or Reset a unit and Weaken it by 3.
14013.Flavor: Eat enough of them, and the world will never be the same…
14013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3; or <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit and Weaken it by 3.

14014.Name: Shrike
14014.Info: Damage up to 6 random enemies by 2.

14015.Name: Wyvern Scale Shield
14015.Info: Boost a unit by the base Power of a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand.
14015.Flavor: Stronger than your average shield and far more stylish.
14015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a unit by the base <color=mycolor>Power</color> of a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand.

14016.Name: Stammelford's Tremors
14016.Flavor: The sorcerer Stammelford moved a mountain that obscured the view from his tower. Rumor has it he could only do so for he'd fettered a d'ao, an earth elemental.

14017.Name: Swallow
14017.Flavor: Symbolizing spring and rejuvenation, the swallow lent its name to this potion that accelerates the rate at which wounds scab over and heal.

14018.Name: Thunderbolt
14018.Info: Boost 3 adjacent units by 3 and give them 2 Armor.
14018.Flavor: The witcher's face changed… his mien turning inhuman, horrifying.
14018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 3 adjacent units by 3 and give them 2 Armor.

14019.Name: Torrential Rain
14019.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 1 Damage to both the Highest and Lowest unit on turn start.
14019.Flavor: Even the rain in this land smells vile.
14019.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to both the Highest and Lowest unit on turn start.

14020.Name: Mahakam Ale
14020.Info: Boost a random ally on each row by 4.
14020.Flavor: Considered to be the dwarves' greatest contribution to world culture.
14020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random ally on each row by 4.

14021.Name: Crow's Eye
14021.Info:
Deal 4 Damage to the Highest enemy on each row.
Deal 1 extra Damage for each copy of this card in your graveyard.
14021.Flavor: A certain famous pirate once so loved this intoxicating herb, he earned the nickname 'Crow's Eye.' The theatrical version of his legend omits this, however, to the great consternation of pirate lore sticklers.
14021.EnhancedInfo:
Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Highest enemy on each row.
Deal 1 extra <color=mycolor>Damage</color> for each copy of this card in your graveyard.

14022.Name: Doppler
14022.Info: Spawn a random Bronze unit from your faction.
14022.Flavor: Humans despise dopplers so much, they feel mere execution does not suffice - so they tie any they catch to a stake, cover them in thick clay and bake them in a fire.
14022.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a random Bronze unit from your faction.

14023.Name: Rock Barrage
14023.Info:
Deal 7 Damage to an enemy and move it to the row above.
If the row is full, destroy the enemy instead.
14023.Flavor: Someday, when you are older, you could get hit by a boulder.
14023.EnhancedInfo:
Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy and move it to the row above.
If the row is full, destroy the enemy instead.

14024.Name: Mastercrafted Spear
14024.Info: Deal Damage equal to the base Power of a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand.
14024.Flavor: Hold that spear up, weakling! Not a single horse shall pass!
14024.EnhancedInfo: Deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> equal to the base <color=mycolor>Power</color> of a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand.

14025.Name: Spores
14025.Info: Deal 2 Damage to all units on an enemy row and clear a Boon from it.
14025.Flavor: Carried by the wind across the Continent... Sowing madness and blight where they fall.
14025.EnhancedInfo: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units on an enemy row and clear a <color=mycolor>Boon</color> from it.

14026.Name: Golden Froth
14026.Info: Apply a Boon to an allied row that Boosts 2 random units by 1 on turn start.
14026.Flavor: Smell that? That's the smell of happiness.
14026.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Boon</color> to an allied row that Boosts 2 random units by 1 on turn start.

14027.Name: Peasant Militia
14027.Info:
Spawn 3 Peasants on a row.
(Peasant; 3 Strength)
14027.Flavor: We's the militia. We keep the peace.

15001.Name: Shupe: Knight
15001.Info: Send Shupe to the Imperial Court Military Academy. Strengthen self to 25; Gain Resilience; Duel a unit; Reset a unit; Destroy all enemies with 3 Power or less.
15001.Flavor: Shupe is known to have quite the imagination. What other troll would look at red cardinals and see wyverns?
15001.EnhancedInfo: Send Shupe to the Imperial Court Military Academy. <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self to 25; Gain <color=mycolor>Resilience</color>; Duel a unit; <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit; Destroy all enemies with 3 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

15002.Name: Shupe: Hunter
15002.Info: Send Shupe to the forests of Dol Blathanna. Deal 15 Damage; Deal 2 Damage to a random enemy 8 times; Replay a Bronze or Silver unit and Boost it by 5; Play a Bronze or Silver unit from your deck; Remove Hazards on your side of the board and Boost your units by 1.
15002.Flavor: Shupe is known to have quite the imagination. What other troll would look at sticks and see crossbow bolts?
15002.EnhancedInfo: Send Shupe to the forests of Dol Blathanna. Deal 15 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>; Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy 8 times; Replay a Bronze or Silver unit and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 5; <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver unit from your deck; Remove Hazards on your side of the board and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> your units by 1.

15003.Name: Shupe: Mage
15003.Info: Send Shupe to the Ban Ard Academy. Draw 1 card; Charm a random enemy; Spawn a random Hazard on all enemy rows; Deal 10 Damage to an enemy, then 5 Damage to adjacent units; Play a non Gold special card from your deck.
15003.Flavor: Shupe is known to have quite the imagination. What other troll would look at holes in the ground and see portals?
15003.EnhancedInfo: Send Shupe to the Ban Ard Academy. <color=mycolor>Draw</color> 1 card; <color=mycolor>Charm</color> a random enemy; <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a random <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> on all enemy rows; Deal 10 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy, then 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to adjacent units; <color=mycolor>Play</color> a non Gold special card from your deck.

15004.Name: Chironex
15004.Info: Deploy: Damage all other units on the battlefield by 2.
15004.Flavor: Gods, that's no unicorn! That's…! – the last words of Vilemar, a famed collector of curiosities.
15004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all other units on the battlefield by 2.

15005.Name: Jade Figurine
15005.Flavor: The figurine expanded in a flash, pulsing and throbbing, changing its shape and structure like a puff of smoke crawling over the floor. Beams of light revealed movement and hardening materials. A moment later, in the center of the magic circle a human form suddenly appeared.

15006.Name: Duda: Agitator
15006.Info: Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to 2 units on each side of this card.
15006.Flavor: Zoltan's parrot had the extraordinary ability to irritate anyone who spent time with it. Including Zoltan.
15006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 2 units on each side of this card.

15007.Name: Duda: Companion
15007.Info: Deploy: Boost 2 units on each side of this card by 2.
15007.Flavor: Knows one hundred words – eighty of them curses, the rest, connectors.
15007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 2 units on each side of this card by 2.

15008.Name: Unicorn
15008.Info: Deploy: Boost all other units on the battlefield by 2.
15008.Flavor: They say unicorns are fond of virgins. Since finding a virgin these days is as hard as finding a unicorn, no one has been able to verify the theory.
15008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all other units on the battlefield by 2.

15009.Name: Chort
15009.Flavor: A member of the Bovine Defense Force. Semper fi!

15012.Name: Cow
15012.Flavor: In Beauclair, everything is better: the wine is sweeter, the cows are bigger and all the ladies are above average.

15013.Name: Clear Skies
15013.Info: Boost all Damaged allies under Hazards by 2 and clear all Hazards from your side.
15013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Damaged allies under Hazards by 2 and clear all Hazards from your side.

15014.Name: Rally
15014.Info: Play a random Bronze unit from your deck.
15014.Flavor: The sun's shinin', Dromle! The sun's shinin'! Maybe there's hope after all…
15014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze unit from your deck.

21001.Name: Dagon
21001.Info: Deploy: Spawn Impenetrable Fog or Torrential Rain.

21002.Name: Arachas Queen
21002.Info:
Deploy: Consume 3 allies and Boost self by their Power.
Immune.
21002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume 3 allies and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by their <color=mycolor>Power</color>.
Immune.

21003.Name: Whispering Hillock
21003.Info: Deploy: Create a Bronze or Silver Organic card.
21003.Flavor: It will rise again. Elsewhere, beyond our reach. Blood will flow once more.
21003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Organic card.

21004.Name: Eredin Bréacc Glas
21004.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Bronze Wild Hunt unit.

21005.Name: Unseen Elder
21005.Info: Deploy: Drain a unit by half (rounded up).
21005.Flavor: No one, not even among the higher vampires, knows exactly how old the Unseen Elder is. They only know they should never, under any circumstances, defy his will.
21005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Drain a unit by half (rounded up).

22001.Name: Old Speartip: Asleep
22001.Info: Deploy: Strengthen all your other Ogroids in hand, deck and on the board by 1.
22001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> all your other Ogroids in hand, deck and on the board by 1.

22002.Name: Draug
22002.Info: Deploy: Resurrect random units to this unit's row as 1-Power Draugirs until you fill the row.
22002.Flavor: Some men cannot admit defeat. Some keep fighting from beyond the grave.
22002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> random units to this unit's row as 1-<color=mycolor>Power</color> Draugirs until you fill the row.

22003.Name: Old Speartip
22003.Info: Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to up to 5 enemies on the opposite row.
22003.Flavor: Oh, you're in a heap of trouble now…
22003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to up to 5 enemies on the opposite row.

22004.Name: Caranthir Ar-Feiniel
22004.Info: Deploy: move two enemies to the opposite row and apply Biting Frost to it.
22004.Flavor: A favorite son who chose a life of villainy.
22004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: move two enemies to the opposite row and apply Biting Frost to it.

22005.Name: Imlerith
22005.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy by 4.
If the enemy is under Biting Frost, Destroy it instead.
22005.Flavor: He boasted that no weapon would ever pierce his armor. And he was right — even in death.
22005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 4.
If the enemy is under Biting Frost, Destroy it instead.

22006.Name: Whispess: Tribute
22006.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Organic card from your deck.
22006.Flavor: I'd be your best – and last.
22006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Organic card from your deck.

22007.Name: Kayran
22007.Info: Deploy: Consume a unit with 8 Power or less and Boost self by its Power.
22007.Flavor: How to kill a kayran? Simple! Take your best sword… then sell it, and hire a witcher.
22007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume a unit with 8 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

22008.Name: Woodland Spirit
22008.Info: Deploy: Spawn 3 Rabid Wolves and apply Impenetrable Fog to the opposite row.
22008.Flavor: We never hunt in these woods. Not even if it means the whole village'll starve.
22008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 3 Rabid Wolves and apply Impenetrable Fog to the opposite row.

22009.Name: Imlerith: Sabbath
22009.Info:
Every turn, on turn end, Duel the Highest enemy.
If this unit survives, Heal it by 2 and give it 2 Armor.
Repeat up to 2 times.
2 Armor.
22009.Flavor: The sisters said you would come. They saw you arrive in the water's surface.
22009.EnhancedInfo:
Every turn, on turn end, Duel the Highest enemy.
If this unit survives, Heal it by 2 and give it 2 Armor.
Repeat up to 2 times.
2 Armor.

22010.Name: Caretaker
22010.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver unit from your opponent's graveyard.
22010.Flavor: There are more things in heaven and earth than all the world's philosophers have dreamt.
22010.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze or Silver unit from your opponent's graveyard.

22011.Name: Miruna
22011.Info: After 2 turns, on turn start, Charm the Highest enemy on the opposite row.
22011.Flavor: Why fight? There are much better ways to work off excess energy…
22011.EnhancedInfo: After 2 turns, on turn start, <color=mycolor>Charm</color> the Highest enemy on the opposite row.

22012.Name: Weavess: Incantation
22012.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Strengthen all your Relicts in hand, deck and on the board by 2; or Play a Bronze or Silver Relict from your deck and Strengthen it by 2.
22012.Flavor: I sense your pain. I see your fear.
22012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> all your Relicts in hand, deck and on the board by 2; or <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Relict from your deck and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 2.

22013.Name: Ge'els
22013.Info:
Deploy: Draw the top Gold card and top Silver card from your deck.
Play one and return the other to the top of your deck.
22013.Flavor: Paintings should convey emotion, not words.
22013.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Draw</color> the top Gold card and top Silver card from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Play</color> one and return the other to the top of your deck.

22014.Name: Brewess: Ritual
22014.Flavor: We'll cut you up, boy. A fine broth you'll make.

23001.Name: Frightener
23001.Info:
Spying. Single-Use.
Deploy: Move an enemy to this unit's row and draw a card.
23001.Flavor: ”What have I done?” the mage cried out, frightened of his own creation.
23001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>. <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move an enemy to this unit's row and <color=mycolor>draw</color> a card.

23002.Name: Imperial Manticore
23002.Flavor: One of the world's oldest and deadliest monsters. I used to feel excitement at moments like this. Now the beast is only an obstacle in my way. Its meat and hot blood will help me survive this icy hell.

23003.Name: Golyat
23003.Info:
Deploy: Boost self by 7.
Whenever this unit is Damaged, deal 2 Damage to self.
23003.Flavor: Some claim Golyat was once a famous knight. Sadly, one day he earned the wrath of the Lady of the Lake, who turned him into a monster.
23003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 7.
Whenever this unit is Damaged, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to self.

23004.Name: Brewess
23004.Info: Deploy: Summon Whispess and Weavess on this row.
23004.Flavor: We'll cut you up, boy. A fine broth you'll make.
23004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Whispess and Weavess on this row.

23005.Name: Colossal Ifrit
23005.Info:
Deploy: Spawn 4 Lesser Ifrits to the right of this unit.
(Lesser Ifrit; 1 Strength; When Summoned, deal 1 Damage to a random enemy)
23005.Flavor: Can't stand the heat? Then you don't stand a chance.
23005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 4 Lesser Ifrits to the right of this unit.
(Lesser Ifrit; 1 Strength; When Summoned, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy)

23006.Name: Ruehin
23006.Info: Deploy: Strengthen all your Insectoid and Cursed units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.
23006.Flavor: No one has ever entered that forest and lived to tell the tale…
23006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> all your Insectoid and Cursed units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.

23007.Name: Weavess
23007.Info: Deploy: Summon Brewess and Whispess on this row.
23007.Flavor: I sense your pain. I see your fear.
23007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Brewess and Whispess on this row.

23008.Name: Whispess
23008.Info: Deploy: Summon Brewess and Weavess on this row.
23008.Flavor: I'd be your best – and last.
23008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Brewess and Weavess on this row.

23009.Name: Jotunn
23009.Info:
Deploy: Move 3 enemies to this row on their side and Damage them by 2.
If that row is affected by Biting Frost, Damage them by 3 instead.
23009.Flavor: Skellige legend claims the mighty and terrible Jotunn, King of Giants, reigned over the isles in ancient times. He was slain by Hemdall, but with his dying breath he vowed to return for Ragh nar Roog.
23009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move 3 enemies to this row on their side and <color=mycolor>Damage</color> them by 2.
If that row is affected by Biting Frost, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> them by 3 instead.

23010.Name: Morvudd
23010.Info:
Deploy: Toggle a unit's Lock status.
If it was an enemy, halve its Power.
23010.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle a unit's <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status.
If it was an enemy, halve its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

23011.Name: Nithral
23011.Info:
Deploy: Deal 6 Damage to an enemy.
Increase Damage by 1 for each Wild Hunt unit in your hand.
23011.Flavor: Each Wild Hunt warrior has gone through a rigorous selection process, but Eredin's personal cavalcade includes only the most brutal and most ferocious of the Aen Elle.
23011.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 6 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
Increase <color=mycolor>Damage</color> by 1 for each Wild Hunt unit in your hand.

23012.Name: Toad Prince
23012.Info: Deploy: Draw a unit, then Consume a unit in your hand and Boost self by its Power.
23012.Flavor: Big, bad, ugly. Squats in the sewers.
23012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Draw</color> a unit, then Consume a unit in your hand and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

23013.Name: Adda: Striga
23013.Info: Deploy: Deal 8 Damage to a non-Monster unit.
23013.Flavor: And the striga's doin' fine. Sure, she takes a bite outta someone from time to time, but you get used to that.

23014.Name: Katakan
23014.Flavor: Drinking the blood of the Continent since the Conjunction.

23015.Name: Ozzrel
23015.Info: Deploy: Consume a Bronze or Silver unit from either graveyard and Boost self by its Power.
23015.Flavor: Some necrophages have taken such a liking to human flesh, they no longer are content to merely dig up corpses...
23015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume a Bronze or Silver unit from either graveyard and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

23016.Name: Abaya
23016.Info: Deploy: Spawn Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Arachas Venom.
23016.Flavor: Seen a lot o' ugly critters in me life – morays, lampreys, blobfish… But never nothin' like this!
23016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Arachas Venom.

23017.Name: Mourntart
23017.Info: Deploy: Consume all Bronze and Silver units in your graveyard and Boost self by 1 for each.
23017.Flavor: Most grave hags feed on rotten remains dug out of graves. Yet some sneak into huts, steal children, kill the elderly and in general make very undesirable neighbors.
23017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume all Bronze and Silver units in your graveyard and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 for each.

23018.Name: Maerolorn
23018.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze Deathwish unit from your deck.
23018.Flavor: No gate nor wall can stop them. Just one tiny crack — that's all they need...
23018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze Deathwish unit from your deck.

23019.Name: She-Troll of Vergen
23019.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze Deathwish unit from your deck, Consume it and Boost self by its base Power.
23019.Flavor: Lover of elf and onion soup.
23019.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze Deathwish unit from your deck, Consume it and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

23020.Name: Devana Runestone
23020.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Monster card.
23020.Flavor: My blades're so sharp, they can cut paper!
23020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Monster card.

23021.Name: Monster Nest
23021.Info: Spawn a Bronze Necrophage or Insectoid unit and Boost it by 1.
23021.Flavor: Damn, the filth's o'errun us… We need a witcher or there's no livin' 'ere!
23021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bronze Necrophage or Insectoid unit and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 1.

23022.Name: Parasite
23022.Info: Choose a unit. If it's an enemy, deal 12 Damage to it. If it's an ally, Boost it by 12.
23022.EnhancedInfo: Choose a unit. If it's an enemy, deal 12 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to it. If it's an ally, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 12.

24001.Name: Cyclops
24001.Info: Deploy: Destroy an ally and deal its Power as Damage to an enemy.
24001.Flavor: Don't stare at his eye, he hates that…
24001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy an ally and deal its <color=mycolor>Power</color> as <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.

24002.Name: Fiend
24002.Flavor: A fiend looks a bit like a deer. An enormous, evil deer.

24003.Name: Ancient Foglet
24003.Info: On turn end, if Impenetrable Fog is on the board, Boost self by 1.
24003.Flavor: Many primal fears lurk in the hearts of men. The fear of the mist is well–founded…
24003.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if Impenetrable Fog is on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.

24004.Name: Archgriffin
24004.Info:
Deploy: Clear Hazards on its row.
Move a Bronze unit from the opponent's graveyard to yours.
24004.Flavor: Considered the embodiment of courage, loyalty and fighting spirit, the very essence of what Griffin Witchers are known for. However, the School of the Griffin was actually named after a knight errant known as Gryphon, who had long ago instilled these values into its founder.
24004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Clear Hazards on its row.
Move a Bronze unit from the opponent's graveyard to yours.

24005.Name: Wild Hunt Rider
24005.Info: Increase the Damage dealt by Biting Frost on the opposite row by 1.
24005.Flavor: First the buffalo horns atop their helms penetrate one's view, then the crest betwixt them, and finally the skull–like face exposed beneath their visors.
24005.EnhancedInfo: Increase the <color=mycolor>Damage</color> dealt by Biting Frost on the opposite row by 1.

24006.Name: Bridge Troll
24006.Info: Deploy: Move a Hazard on an enemy row to a different enemy row.
24006.Flavor: This here bridge? Trolls built it a long time ago. Sat under it, made folk pay 'em a hefty copper to pass. Thing is, not many folk pass this way. So they all packed up, went their way. Not the bridge, though. It stayed.
24006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> on an enemy row to a different enemy row.

24007.Name: Alpha Werewolf
24007.Info: Spawn a Rabid Wolf on either side on contact with Full Moon.
24007.Flavor: The most ferocious among these cursed are not even deterred by silver and alchemy's fiery pains.
24007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Rabid Wolf on either side on contact with Full Moon.

24008.Name: Griffin
24008.Info: Deploy: Trigger the Deathwish of a Bronze ally.
24008.Flavor: Afraid for their lives, the residents of Hengfors cowered behind thick city walls. A lot of good that did them...
24008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Trigger the Deathwish of a Bronze ally.

24009.Name: Nekker Warrior
24009.Info: Deploy: Choose a Bronze ally and add 2 copies of it to the bottom of your deck.
24009.Flavor: Take heed, gents, there's nekkers under this here bridge.
24009.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a Bronze ally and add 2 copies of it to the bottom of your deck.

24010.Name: Arachas Behemoth
24010.Info:
Whenever you Consume a unit, Spawn an Arachas Hatchling.
Repeat up to 3 times.
(Arachas Hatchling; 3 Strength; Summon all Arachas Drones on this row)
24010.Flavor: Like a cross between a crab, a spider… and a mountain.
24010.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever you Consume a unit, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> an Arachas Hatchling.
Repeat up to 3 times.
(Arachas Hatchling; 3 Strength; <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all Arachas Drones on this row)

24011.Name: Rotfiend
24011.Info: Deathwish: Damage all units on the opposite row by 2.
24011.Flavor: You'll smell them long before you see them.
24011.EnhancedInfo: Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on the opposite row by 2.

24012.Name: Forktail
24012.Info: Deploy: Consume 2 allies and Boost self by their Power.
24012.Flavor: As for forktails, bait them thusly: pound a stake in the soil, bind a goat to it, then hide ye in nearto shrubbery posthaste.
24012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume 2 allies and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by their <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

24013.Name: Archespore
24013.Info:
On turn start, move to a random row and deal 1 Damage to a random enemy.
Deathwish: Deal 4 Damage to a random enemy.
24013.Flavor: Folklore claims they sprout from soil watered with the blood of the dying. Thus they flourish in grounds consecrated by pogroms, dark rituals or brutal murders.
24013.EnhancedInfo:
On turn start, move to a random row and deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.
Deathwish: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.

24014.Name: Drowner
24014.Info:
Deploy: Move an enemy to the opposite row and deal 2 Damage to it.
If that row is under a Hazard, deal 5 Damage instead.
24014.Flavor: Though the witchman lusts for gold, for the smiting of a drowner thou shalt give him but a silver penny, or three halfpence, at most.
24014.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move an enemy to the opposite row and deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to it.
If that row is under a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color>, deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> instead.

24015.Name: Wild Hunt Drakkar
24015.Info: Deploy: Boost all Wild Hunt allies by 1. Whenever an allied Wild Hunt unit appears boost it by 1.
24015.Flavor: Waves pummel the shore, waves pushed by the prow of the spectral Naglfar. Hemdall's horn rings in the air, and Hemdall stands facing his enemies atop Bifrost, the burning rainbow. The White Frost is nigh, nigh is the time of gale and storm…
24015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Wild Hunt allies by 1. Whenever an allied Wild Hunt unit appears <color=mycolor>boost</color> it by 1.

24016.Name: Wild Hunt Warrior
24016.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to an enemy.
If the enemy is destroyed or is under Biting Frost, Boost self by 2.
24016.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If the enemy is destroyed or is under Biting Frost, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

24017.Name: Werewolf
24017.Info:
Boost by 7 on contact with Full Moon.
Immune.
24017.Flavor: Some say lycanthropy's contagious - get bit by a werewolf, you turn into one yourself. Witchers know that's nonsense, of course - only a powerful curse can bring on this condition.
24017.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Boost</color> by 7 on contact with Full Moon.
Immune.

24018.Name: Celaeno Harpy
24018.Info: Deploy: Spawn 2 Harpy Eggs to its left. (Harpy Egg; 1 Strength; When Consumed by another unit, Boost that unit by an additional 4. Deathwish: Spawn a Harpy Hatchling on a random row) (Harpy Hatchling; 1 Strength)
24018.Flavor: Common harpies feed on carrion. Celaeno harpies… they feed on dreams.
24018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 2 Harpy Eggs to its left. (Harpy Egg; 1 Strength; When Consumed by another unit, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> that unit by an additional 4. Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Harpy Hatchling on a random row) (Harpy Hatchling; 1 Strength)

24019.Name: Cockatrice
24019.Flavor: Always strikes between the vertebrae, under your left kidney or straight into your aorta. That way, it only needs to strike once.

24020.Name: D'ao
24020.Flavor: How do you fight an earth elemental? You don't. You run. Fast as you can.

24021.Name: Ice Giant
24021.Info:
Deploy: For every Biting Frost on the board, Boost self by 3.
Every time a Biting Frost appears on the board, Boost self by 3.
24021.Flavor: Fled one time in my life. From the Ice Giant. And I'm not a bit ashamed.
24021.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: For every Biting Frost on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3.
Every time a Biting Frost appears on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3.

24022.Name: Vran Warrior
24022.Info:
Deploy: Consume the unit to the right and Boost self by its Power.
Every 2 turns, on turn start, repeat its ability.
24022.Flavor: They sat still on their horses, seemingly relaxed. He saw their weapons – short spears with wide tips. Swords with oddly forged guards. Battle axes. Toothed gisarmes.
24022.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume the unit to the right and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.
Every 2 turns, on turn start, repeat its ability.

24023.Name: Wyvern
24023.Info: Deploy: Deal 5 Damage to an enemy.
24023.Flavor: Imagine a cross between a winged snake and a nightmare. Wyverns are worse.

24024.Name: Lamia
24024.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to an enemy.
If the enemy is under Blood Moon, deal 7 Damage instead.
24024.Flavor: The fool paid heed to superstition, stuffed his ears with wax and didn't hear the warnings. He ran his ship straight into the rocks.
24024.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If the enemy is under Blood Moon, deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> instead.

24025.Name: Barbegazi
24025.Info:
Deploy: Consume an ally and Boost self by its Power.
Resilient.
24025.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume an ally and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.
Resilient.

24026.Name: Ekimmara
24026.Flavor: Me? 'Fraid o' some ploughin' eki-what's-it? Why, it's just an overgrown bat!

24027.Name: Werecat
24027.Info: Deploy: Deal 5 Damage to an enemy, then deal 1 Damage to all enemies under Blood Moon.
24027.Flavor: He hates it when you scratch his belly.
24027.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy, then deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies under Blood Moon.

24028.Name: Foglet
24028.Info: Whenever you apply Impenetrable Fog to an enemy row, Summon a copy of this unit from your deck to the opposite row.
24028.Flavor: Fog creeps on little cat feet. Foglets creep over the bodies of their victims.
24028.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you apply Impenetrable Fog to an enemy row, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit from your deck to the opposite row.

24029.Name: Ghoul
24029.Info: Deploy: Consume a Bronze or Silver unit from your graveyard and Boost self by its Power.
24029.Flavor: If ghouls are part of the Circle of Life… then it's one vicious circle.
24029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume a Bronze or Silver unit from your graveyard and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

24030.Name: Harpy
24030.Info: Summon a copy of this unit on a random row whenever you destroy an allied Beast.
24030.Flavor: There are many species of harpy, and all are kleptomaniacs.
24030.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit on a random row whenever you destroy an allied Beast.

24031.Name: Nekker
24031.Info:
Whenever you Consume a card, Boost this unit by 1 if in hand, deck or on the board.
Deathwish: Summon a copy of this unit from your deck in the same position.
24031.Flavor: These little guys are almost cute, if you ignore the whole vicious killer aspect.
24031.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever you Consume a card, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> this unit by 1 if in hand, deck or on the board.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit from your deck in the same position.

24032.Name: Wild Hunt Hound
24032.Info: Deploy: Play Biting Frost from your deck.
24032.Flavor: Cry 'Havoc!', and let slip the dogs of war.

24033.Name: Siren
24033.Info: Deploy: Play Moonlight from your deck.
24033.Flavor: Legends claim they lure sailors to their doom with their entrancing songs… though more likely, the sailors were more entranced by their other ample charms.

24034.Name: Ice Troll
24034.Info:
Deploy: Duel an enemy.
If the enemy is under Biting Frost, deal double Damage.
24034.Flavor: Trolls come in many varieties, with differing shapes, sizes and predilections, though always with about as much brains as a bucket of rusty nails.
24034.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Duel an enemy.
If the enemy is under Biting Frost, deal double <color=mycolor>Damage</color>.

24035.Name: Arachas Drone
24035.Info: Deploy: Summon all copies of this unit on this row.
24035.Flavor: Ugly – nature's way of saying stay away.
24035.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all copies of this unit on this row.

24036.Name: Wild Hunt Navigator
24036.Info: Deploy: Choose a non-Mage Wild Hunt ally and play a copy of it from your deck.
24036.Flavor: For hundreds of years, Avallac'h tried to recreate the Elder Blood gene through back breeding - yet the elven children thus fostered were but dim sparks compared to Lara's flame.
24036.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a non-Mage Wild Hunt ally and <color=mycolor>play</color> a copy of it from your deck.

24037.Name: Slyzard
24037.Info: Deploy: Consume a different Bronze unit from your graveyard, then play a copy of it from your deck.
24037.Flavor: No man alive, no matter his brawn, no matter his skill, can parry a blow dealt by the tail of a slyzard, the pincers of a giant scorpion or the claws of a griffin.
24037.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume a different Bronze unit from your graveyard, then <color=mycolor>play</color> a copy of it from your deck.

24038.Name: Moonlight
24038.Info:
Spawn Full Moon, or Blood Moon.
(Full Moon; Apply a Boon to an allied row that Boosts a random Beast or Vampire by 2 on turn start) 
(Blood Moon; Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 2 Damage to all units on contact)
24038.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Full Moon, or Blood Moon.
(Full Moon; Apply a <color=mycolor>Boon</color> to an allied row that Boosts a random Beast or Vampire by 2 on turn start) 
(Blood Moon; Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units on contact)

25001.Name: Lesser D'ao
25001.Flavor: They're easily mistaken for rocks. Many a troll's been unpleasantly surprised by gastric grief on that very account.

25002.Name: Arachas Hatchling
25002.Info: Summon all Arachas Drones on this row.
25002.Flavor: Nature sometimes give lie to the phrase youth is beauty.
25002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all Arachas Drones on this row.

25004.Name: Harpy Egg
25004.Info:
When Consumed by another unit, Boost that unit by an additional 4.
Deathwish: Spawn a Harpy Hatchling on a random row.
(Harpy Hatchling; 1 Strength)
25004.Flavor: A harpy egg omelet - a delicious delicacy, good sir. Quite dear, too, for as you might surmise, the wretches don't part with their eggs willingly.
25004.EnhancedInfo:
When Consumed by another unit, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> that unit by an additional 4.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Harpy Hatchling on a random row.
(Harpy Hatchling; 1 Strength)

25006.Name: Lesser Ifrit
25006.Info: When Summoned, deal 1 Damage to a random enemy.
25006.Flavor: A certain mage thought them cute. It was his fate that gave rise to the saying Don't play with fire…
25006.EnhancedInfo: When Summoned, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.

25007.Name: Rabid Wolf
25007.Flavor: Relax, I know how to tame wolves…– Dunbar the Hunter's last words.

25008.Name: Blood Moon
25008.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 2 Damage to all units on contact.
25008.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units on contact.

25009.Name: Full Moon
25009.Info: Apply a Boon to an allied row that Boosts a random Beast or Vampire by 2 on turn start.
25009.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Boon</color> to an allied row that Boosts a random Beast or Vampire by 2 on turn start.

31001.Name: Jan Calveit
31001.Info: Deploy: Look at the top 3 cards from your deck, then play 1.
31001.Flavor: “To prepare for the future, it’s best to first know it.”
31001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at the top 3 cards from your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

31002.Name: Emhyr var Emreis
31002.Info: Deploy: Play a card from your hand, then return a Bronze or Silver ally to your hand.
31002.Flavor: They do not call me the Patient. Take care they do not call you the Headless.
31002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a card from your hand, then return a Bronze or Silver ally to your hand.

31003.Name: Morvran Voorhis
31003.Flavor: The summer sun reflected in the quiet waters of the Alba – that's Nilfgaard to me.

31004.Name: Usurper
31004.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Create any Leader and Boost it by 2.
31004.Flavor: Why should something as trivial as birth decide who rules over us?

32001.Name: Rainfarn of Attre
32001.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Spying unit from your deck.
32001.Flavor: When Cintra fell, Attre followed, leaving its defenders a choice: accept the Nilfgaardian leash or die.
32001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver <color=mycolor>Spying</color> unit from your deck.

32002.Name: Xarthisius
32002.Info: Deploy: Look at your opponent's deck and move a card to the bottom.
32002.Flavor: Astrology, hydromancy, haruspicy, ceromancy. Ovomancy, spodomancy, metroscopy, brontoscopy…
32002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at your opponent's deck and move a card to the bottom.

32003.Name: Vattier de Rideaux
32003.Info:
Deploy: Reveal up to 2 cards from your hand.
For each, Reveal 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
32003.Flavor: There's never been a problem a well–planned assassination couldn't solve.
32003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> up to 2 cards from your hand.
For each, <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

32004.Name: Stefan Skellen
32004.Info: Deploy: Choose a card from your deck, Boost it by 5 and move it to the top of your deck.
32004.Flavor: My mark scars the face of our future empress. That is my proudest achievement.
32004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a card from your deck, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 5 and move it to the top of your deck.

32005.Name: Tibor Eggebracht
32005.Info: Deploy, Truce: Boost self by 15, then your opponent draws a Revealed Bronze card.
32005.Flavor: Tibor's zeal was legendary. It was said when the emperor passed, he'd not so much bow as somersault.
32005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 15, then your opponent draws a Revealed Bronze card.

32006.Name: Vilgefortz
32006.Info: Deploy: Destroy an ally, then play top card from your deck; or Truce: Destroy an enemy, then your opponent draws a Revealed Bronze card.
32006.Flavor: We are all pawns on his board. Playing a game whose rules we do not know.
32006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy an ally, then <color=mycolor>play</color> top card from your deck; or <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: Destroy an enemy, then your opponent draws a Revealed Bronze card.

32007.Name: Shilard
32007.Info:
Deploy, Truce: Draw a card from both decks.
Keep one and give the other to your opponent.
32007.Flavor: A diplomat is a man who uses many more words than necessary to express much less than he knows.
32007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: <color=mycolor>Draw</color> a card from both decks.
Keep one and give the other to your opponent.

32008.Name: Menno Coehoorn
32008.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy by 4.
If it's Spying, destroy it.
32008.Flavor: I'll take an attentive reconnaissance unit over a fine brigade any day.
32008.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 4.
If it's <color=mycolor>Spying</color>, destroy it.

32009.Name: Leo Bonhart
32009.Info: Deploy: Reveal one of your units and deal Damage equal to its base Power to an enemy.
32009.Flavor: He would just sit there and stare at me, not saying a word. His eyes, they were… fish-like, somehow. No brows, no lashes… Just these balls of water, with a black stone sunk in each. He would devour me with those eyes in total silence. That frightened me more than the beatings.
32009.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> one of your units and deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> equal to its base <color=mycolor>Power</color> to an enemy.

32010.Name: Yennefer: Enchantress
32010.Info: Deploy: Spawn the last Bronze or Silver Spell you played.
32010.Flavor: It's best not to get in Yennefer's way. Especially when she's in a hurry.
32010.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> the last Bronze or Silver Spell you played.

32011.Name: Letho: Kingslayer
32011.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Destroy an enemy Leader, then Boost self by 5; or play a Bronze or Silver Tactic from your deck.
32011.Flavor: Why does this monk wear studded gloves…?
32011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Destroy an enemy Leader, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 5; or <color=mycolor>play</color> a Bronze or Silver Tactic from your deck.

32012.Name: Yennefer: Divination
32012.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver Soldier from your opponent's graveyard.
32012.Flavor: Yes, I have seen the future. And you're not in it.
32012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze or Silver Soldier from your opponent's graveyard.

32013.Name: Cahir Dyffryn
32013.Flavor: His eyes flashed under his winged helmet. Fire gleamed from his sword's blade.

32014.Name: Letho of Gulet
32014.Info:
Double Agent.
Deploy: Toggle 2 units' Lock on the same row, then Drain all their Power.
32014.Flavor: Witchers never die in their beds.
32014.EnhancedInfo:
Double Agent.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle 2 units' <color=mycolor>Lock</color> on the same row, then Drain all their <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

32015.Name: Assassination
32015.Info:
Deal 9 Damage to an enemy.
Repeat once.
32015.Flavor: In Nilfgaard, trustful people are considered an endangered species.
32015.EnhancedInfo:
Deal 9 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
Repeat once.

33001.Name: Joachim de Wett
33001.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Play the top non-Spying Bronze or Silver unit from your deck and Boost it by 10.
33001.Flavor: To describe the manner in which Duke de Wett led the Verden Group as incompetent would be far too kind.
33001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> the top non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> Bronze or Silver unit from your deck and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 10.

33002.Name: False Ciri
33002.Info:
Spying.
If Spying, on turn start, Boost self by 1. If spying move to oposite row after you pass.
Deathwish: Destroy the Lowest unit on the row.
33002.Flavor: Here she comes, he thought, our imperial interest. A mock-princess, a mock-queen for Cintra. A mock-ruler for the mouth of the Yarra, future lifeblood of the empire.
33002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
If <color=mycolor>Spying</color>, on turn start, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1. If <color=mycolor>spying</color> move to oposite row after you pass.
Deathwish: Destroy the Lowest unit on the row.

33003.Name: The Guardian
33003.Info: Deploy: Add a Lesser Guardian to the top of your opponent's deck.
33003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Add a Lesser Guardian to the top of your opponent's deck.

33004.Name: Cantarella
33004.Info:
Spying. Single-Use.
Deploy: Look at the top 2 cards from your deck.
Draw one and move the other to the bottom of your deck.
33004.Flavor: Men require constant alluring. Mystique and refinement do the job quite well.
33004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>. <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at the top 2 cards from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Draw</color> one and move the other to the bottom of your deck.

33005.Name: Assire var Anahid
33005.Info: Deploy: Return 2 Bronze or Silver cards from either graveyard to their respective decks.
33005.Flavor: Nilfgaardian mages do have a choice: servile submission, or the gallows.
33005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Return 2 Bronze or Silver cards from either graveyard to their respective decks.

33006.Name: Albrich
33006.Info:
Single-Use.
Deploy, Truce: Each player draws a card.
The opponent's card is Revealed.
33006.Flavor: A ball of fire? Why, naturally. Whatsoever Your Imperial Majesty desires.
33006.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: Each player draws a card.
The opponent's card is Revealed.

33007.Name: Sweers
