33007.Info: Deploy: Choose an enemy or a Revealed unit in your opponent's hand, then move all copies of it from their deck to the graveyard.
33007.Flavor: And hands off the girl! Whatever we may be, we're not savages.
33007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose an enemy or a Revealed unit in your opponent's hand, then move all copies of it from their deck to the graveyard.

33008.Name: Henry var Attre
33008.Info:
Deploy: Conceal any number of units.
If allies, Boost them by 2.
If enemies, deal 2 Damage to them.
33008.Flavor: The line between diplomacy and espionage is a thin one, especially in Nilfgaard.
33008.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Conceal any number of units.
If allies, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> them by 2.
If enemies, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to them.

33009.Name: Hefty Helge
33009.Info:
Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to all enemies except those on the opposite row.
If this unit was Revealed, deal 1 Damage to all enemies instead.
33009.Flavor: Not the best for taking cities, but great for razing them to the ground.
33009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies except those on the opposite row.
If this unit was Revealed, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies instead.

33010.Name: Auckes
33010.Flavor: Letho's got a plan… what could go wrong?

33011.Name: Peter Saar Gwynleve
33011.Info: Deploy: Choose a unit. Reset it. If its an ally Strengthen it by 3. If its enemy Weaken it by 3.
33011.Flavor: These are not the hands of an Excellency, but of a farmer. So we speak peasant to peasant.
33011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a unit. <color=mycolor>Reset</color> it. If its an ally <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3. If its enemy Weaken it by 3.

33012.Name: Serrit
33012.Info: Deploy: Choose an enemy or a Revealed opposing unit. If its on board Deal 7 Damage. If its a Revealed card set it to 1.
33012.Flavor: We do what we must. I am not ashamed of that.
33012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose an enemy or a Revealed opposing unit. If its on board Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>. If its a Revealed card set it to 1.

33013.Name: Cynthia
33013.Info: Deploy: Reveal the Highest unit in your opponent's hand and Boost self by its Power.
33013.Flavor: Cynthia's talents can be deadly. She needs a tight leash.
33013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> the Highest unit in your opponent's hand and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

33014.Name: Vrygheff
33014.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze Machine from your deck.
33014.Flavor: An eye for an eye only ends when the whole world's blind.
33014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze Machine from your deck.

33015.Name: Vanhemar
33015.Info: Deploy: Spawn Biting Frost, Clear Skies or Shrike.
33015.Flavor: For a fire mage, he's not very… flamboyant.
33015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Biting Frost, Clear Skies or Shrike.

33016.Name: Vreemde
33016.Info: Deploy: Create a Bronze Nilfgaardian Soldier.
33016.Flavor: The Great Sun shall warm the North with its rays, even if it means I must slaughter you all!

33017.Name: Ceallach Dyffryn
33017.Info: Deploy: Spawn an Ambassador, Assassin or Emissary.
33017.Flavor: Your Imperial Highness… blurted out the seneschal, whose presence until now had been thoroughly ignored. I beg your pardon, but Cahir… My son...

33018.Name: Fringilla Vigo
33018.Info:
Double Agent.
Deploy: Copy the Power from the unit to the left to the unit to the right.
33018.Flavor: Magic is the highest good. It transcends all borders and divisions.
33018.EnhancedInfo:
Double Agent.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Copy the <color=mycolor>Power</color> from the unit to the left to the unit to the right.

33019.Name: Dazhbog Runestone
33019.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Nilfgaard card.
33019.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Nilfgaard card.

33020.Name: Treason
33020.Info: Force 2 adjacent enemies to Duel each other.
33020.Flavor: Many believe the empire's power rests upon the shoulders of its disciplined army and dutiful mages. In truth, the Nilfgaardian floren rules the world.
33020.EnhancedInfo: Force 2 adjacent enemies to Duel each other.

33021.Name: Cadaverine
33021.Info: Choose One: Deal 3 Damage to an enemy and all units that share its categories; or destroy a Bronze or Silver Neutral enemy.
33021.Flavor: I don't trust my life to chance. I trust it to a thick coating of Cadaverine on my blade.
33021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy and all units that share its categories; or destroy a Bronze or Silver Neutral enemy.

33022.Name: Nilfgaardian Gate
33022.Info: Play a Bronze or Silver Officer from your deck and Boost it by 1.
33022.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Officer from your deck and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 1.

33023.Name: Slave Driver
33023.Info: Deploy: Set an ally's Power to 1 and deal Damage to an enemy by the amount of Power lost.
33023.Flavor: What drives a slave driver? A solitary purpose: to see his orders carried out to the letter.
33023.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Set an ally's <color=mycolor>Power</color> to 1 and deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy by the amount of <color=mycolor>Power</color> lost.

34001.Name: Vicovaro Novice
34001.Info: Deploy: Look at 2 random Bronze Alchemy cards from your deck, then play 1.
34001.Flavor: Mages in Nilfgaard are disposable. If one disappoints the Emperor, a dozen others await to provide what he requires.
34001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random Bronze Alchemy cards from your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

34002.Name: Emissary
34002.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Look at 2 random Bronze units from your deck, then play 1.
34002.Flavor: But… but there's no justice in it! One does not kill the messenger!
34002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random Bronze units from your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

34003.Name: Impera Brigade
34003.Info:
Deploy: Boost self by 2 for each Spying enemy.
Whenever a Spying enemy appears, Boost self by 2.
34003.Flavor: The Impera Brigade never surrenders. Ever.
34003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2 for each <color=mycolor>Spying</color> enemy.
Whenever a <color=mycolor>Spying</color> enemy appears, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

34004.Name: Nilfgaardian Knight
34004.Info:
Deploy: Reveal a random card in your hand of the lowest colour possible.
2 Armor.
34004.Flavor: Sons of noble houses, born in the City of the Golden Towers, form the elite backbone of the Imperial Army.
34004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> a random card in your hand of the lowest colour possible.
2 Armor.

34005.Name: Impera Enforcers
34005.Info:
Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to an enemy.
For each Spying enemy that appears during your turn, deal 2 Damage to an enemy.
34005.Flavor: Members of the emperor's fanatic body guard fight to the bitter end.
34005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
For each <color=mycolor>Spying</color> enemy that appears during your turn, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.

34006.Name: Master of Disguise
34006.Flavor: O Great Sun which dost in Heavens fly, save us from the lice which do so stubbornly infest our bloomers.

34007.Name: Alba Spearman
34007.Info: Boost self by 1 whenever either player draws a card.
34007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 whenever either player draws a card.

34008.Name: Infiltrator
34008.Info: Deploy: Toggle a unit's Spying status.
34008.Flavor: You can run, but you'll never hide.

34009.Name: Alchemist
34009.Flavor: Two ounces of calcium equum, one ounce of rubedo…

34010.Name: Standard Bearer
34010.Info: Boost an ally by 2 whenever you play a Soldier.
34010.Flavor: You shall defend this standard if it costs you your lives! Gloir aen Ard Feainn!
34010.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> an ally by 2 whenever you <color=mycolor>play</color> a Soldier.

34011.Name: Rot Tosser
34011.Info:
Deploy: Spawn a Cow Carcass on an enemy row.
(Cow Carcass; 1 Strength; After 2 turns, on turn end, destroy all the other Lowest units on the row and destroy self)
34011.Flavor: Let historians debate whether spreading plague in a besieged city is ethical. We just care if it's effective.
34011.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Cow Carcass on an enemy row.
(Cow Carcass; 1 Strength; After 2 turns, on turn end, destroy all the other Lowest units on the row and destroy self)

34012.Name: Slave Hunter
34012.Info: Deploy: Charm a Bronze enemy with 3 Power or less.
34012.Flavor: The trick is to break their wills - but not their bodies.
34012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Charm</color> a Bronze enemy with 3 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

34013.Name: Sentry
34013.Info: Deploy: Boost all copies of a Soldier by 2.
34013.Flavor: I can't even see over this bloody thing.
34013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all copies of a Soldier by 2.

34014.Name: Alba Armored Cavalry
34014.Info: Whenever an ally appears, Boost self by 1.
34014.Flavor: The wedge of riders thundered into the phalanx with crushing momentum. Like a dagger thrust into an exposed belly, the Alba Division swept unhindered through everything between it and the vital organs of the Temerian Infantry.
34014.EnhancedInfo: Whenever an ally appears, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.

34015.Name: Deithwen Arbalest
34015.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to an enemy.
If it's Spying, deal 8 Damage instead.
34015.Flavor: I aim for the knees. Always.
34015.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If it's <color=mycolor>Spying</color>, deal 8 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> instead.

34016.Name: Mangonel
34016.Info:
Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to a random enemy.
Repeat its ability whenever you Reveal a card.
34016.Flavor: This model specializes in slinging corpses and ripe dung.
34016.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.
Repeat its ability whenever you <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> a card.

34017.Name: Nauzicaa Sergeant
34017.Info: Deploy: Clear Hazards from its row and Boost an ally or a Revealed unit by 3.
34017.Flavor: The Emperor will teach the North discipline.
34017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Clear Hazards from its row and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> an ally or a Revealed unit by 3.

34018.Name: Combat Engineer
34018.Info:
Deploy: Toggle the Resilience status of an ally.
Crew.
34018.Flavor: Want irrefutable proof of civilization's advance? Look at war. Man gets better at killing with each one.
34018.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle the <color=mycolor>Resilience</color> status of an ally.
Crew.

34019.Name: Fire Scorpion
34019.Info:
Deploy: Deal 5 Damage to an enemy.
Whenever you Reveal this unit, trigger its ability.
34019.Flavor: Name's terribly misleading, makes it sound like some corpulent reddish arachnid, not an exquisitely engineered weapon of mass destruction...
34019.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
Whenever you <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> this unit, trigger its ability.

34020.Name: Nauzicaa Brigade
34020.Info:
Deploy: Damage a Spying unit by 7.
If it was destroyed, Strengthen self by 4.
34020.Flavor: They call us Death's Heads. Care to find out why?
34020.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> a <color=mycolor>Spying</color> unit by 7.
If it was destroyed, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 4.

34021.Name: Spotter
34021.Info: Deploy: Choose a Bronze or Silver Revealed unit in either hand and Boost self by half its base Power.
34021.Flavor: The North has nothing with which it could surprise us.
34021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a Bronze or Silver Revealed unit in either hand and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by half its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

34022.Name: Viper Witcher
34022.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage for each Alchemy card in your starting deck.
34022.Flavor: Viper Witchers are trained to fight with twin blades, often referred to as “fangs”. This style focuses on fast and furious strikes aimed to overwhelm their target, be it monster or man.
34022.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> for each Alchemy card in your starting deck.

34023.Name: Daerlan Soldier
34023.Info: Whenever you Reveal this unit, play it on a random row and draw a card.
34023.Flavor: Learned a lot at Braibant Military Academy. How to scrub potatoes, for instance.
34023.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> this unit, <color=mycolor>play</color> it on a random row and <color=mycolor>draw</color> a card.

34024.Name: Alba Pikeman
34024.Info:
After 1 turn, on turn start, Summon a copy of this unit on its row.
2 Armor.
34024.Flavor: Pledge your allegiance to our Emperor, Emhyr var Emreis… or die.
34024.EnhancedInfo:
After 1 turn, on turn start, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit on its row.
2 Armor.

34025.Name: Imperial Golem
34025.Info: Summon a copy of this unit on a random row whenever you Reveal a card in your opponent's hand.
34025.Flavor: The most powerful of Nilfgaard's mages have mastered the art of creating golems. On a few occasions, they've even managed to make them fight for the imperial cause…
34025.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit on a random row whenever you <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> a card in your opponent's hand.

34026.Name: Magne Division
34026.Info: Deploy: Play a random Bronze Item from your deck.
34026.Flavor: I know the Emperor defends all his lands... but a garrison in this blasted waste is like a chastity belt on a grave hag.
34026.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze Item from your deck.

34027.Name: Slave Infantry
34027.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Doomed default copies of this unit on your other rows.
34027.Flavor: A free man's got a choice. A slave's choices are made for him.
34027.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Doomed default copies of this unit on your other rows.

34028.Name: Ambassador
34028.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Boost an ally by 12.
34028.Flavor: A spy? No, that's saying far too much. I consider myself more of an observer.

34029.Name: Assassin
34029.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Deal 10 Damage to the unit to the left.
34029.Flavor: Assassin — one of the most popular professions at the imperial court, just after scribe and courtesan.
34029.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 10 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the unit to the left.

34030.Name: Vicovaro Medic
34030.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard.
34030.Flavor: Well... At least, I can't make you more dead...
34030.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard.

34031.Name: Venendal Elite
34031.Info: Deploy: Switch this unit's Power with that of a Revealed unit.
34031.Flavor: Ebbing is famed for its top-notch mercenaries and light cavalry.
34031.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Switch this unit's <color=mycolor>Power</color> with that of a Revealed unit.

34032.Name: Recruit
34032.Info: Deploy: Play a random different Bronze Soldier from your deck.
34032.Flavor: His is not to reason why, his is but… to peel one damned spud after another.
34032.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random different Bronze Soldier from your deck.

34033.Name: Ointment
34033.Info: Resurrect a Bronze unit with 5 Power or less.
34033.Flavor: Will it help? Who knows. Shouldn't do any harm, though. Probably.
34033.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze unit with 5 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

35001.Name: Lesser Guardian
35001.Flavor: Stone fists to stop intruders armed with swords. Ironclad logic to stop those armed with lies.

35002.Name: Cow Carcass
35002.Info:
Spying.
After 2 turns, on turn end, destroy all the other Lowest units on the row and destroy self.
35002.Flavor: That a bird? That a griffin? Naye! That's a…
35002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
After 2 turns, on turn end, destroy all the other Lowest units on the row and destroy self.

41001.Name: King Radovid V
41001.Info:
Deploy: Toggle 2 units' Lock statuses.
If enemies, deal 5 Damage to them.
Crew.
41001.Flavor: “They say it’s the game of kings. That chess teaches one to think strategically. What a load of rubbish! Both sides have identical pieces, the rules stay invariably the same. How does that mirror real life?”
41001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle 2 units' <color=mycolor>Lock</color> statuses.
If enemies, deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to them.
Crew.

41002.Name: Princess Adda
41002.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Bronze Northern Realms Cursed Unit.
41002.Flavor: Freed from a curse inflicted out of jealousy, only to return to a court filled with little else.
41002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bronze Northern Realms Cursed Unit.

41003.Name: King Foltest
41003.Info:
Deploy: Boost all other allies and your non-Spying units in hand and deck by 1.
Crew.
41003.Flavor: Don't need advisors and their schemes. I place my trust in my soldiers' blades.
41003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all other allies and your non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> units in hand and deck by 1.
Crew.

41004.Name: King Henselt
41004.Info:
Deploy: Choose a Bronze Machine or Kaedweni ally and play all copies of it from your deck.
Crew.
41004.Flavor: Fuck with the unicorn and you get the horn.
41004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a Bronze Machine or Kaedweni ally and <color=mycolor>play</color> all copies of it from your deck.
Crew.

42001.Name: Dandelion
42001.Info: Deploy: Boost 3 units in your deck by 2.
42001.Flavor: Dandelion, you're a cynic, a lecher, a liar – and my best friend.

42002.Name: Bloody Baron
42002.Info: Whenever an enemy is destroyed, if in hand, deck or on the board, Boost self by 1.
42002.Flavor: I've not been a good father, I know, but… perhaps it's not too late.
42002.EnhancedInfo: Whenever an enemy is destroyed, if in hand, deck or on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.

42003.Name: Seltkirk of Gulet
42003.Flavor: Though famed for his many virtues, his indomitable courage first and foremost, Seltkirk was not spared the fate which met all those killed in the Battle of Upper Aedirn.

42004.Name: Vandergrift
42004.Info:
Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to all enemies.
If a unit is destroyed, apply Ragh Nar Roog to its row.
42004.Flavor: The general thought the war for the Lormark would end quickly, with minimal losses… yet wound up fighting it for all eternity.
42004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies.
If a unit is destroyed, apply Ragh Nar Roog to its row.

42005.Name: John Natalis
42005.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Tactics card from your deck. Shuffle the others back.
42005.Flavor: That square should bear the names of my soldiers, of the dead. Not mine.
42005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Tactics card from your deck. Shuffle the others back.

42006.Name: Keira Metz
42006.Info: Deploy: Spawn Alzur's Thunder, Thunderbolt or Arachas Venom.
42006.Flavor: If I'm to die today, I wish to look smashing for the occasion.
42006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Alzur's Thunder, Thunderbolt or Arachas Venom.

42007.Name: Roche: Merciless
42007.Info: Deploy, Choose one: Play 1 Silver or Bronze Temeria card from your deck with power less or equal then self; or destroy conceled ambush enemy unit.
42007.Flavor: Fear does not befit us. Yet, there is a certain d'hoine... Vernon Roche. Be wary of him.
42007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, Choose one: <color=mycolor>Play</color> 1 Silver or Bronze Temeria card from your deck with <color=mycolor>power</color> less or equal then self; or destroy conceled <color=mycolor>ambush</color> enemy unit.

42008.Name: Sigismund Dijkstra
42008.Info:
Spying.
Deploy: Play 2 random cards from your deck.

42009.Name: Shani
42009.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a non-Cursed Bronze or Silver unit and give it 2 Armor.
42009.Flavor: I'm a medic. I tend to know what I'm doing when I prescribe something.
42009.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a non-Cursed Bronze or Silver unit and give it 2 Armor.

42010.Name: Kiyan
42010.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Create a Bronze or Silver Alchemy card; or Play a Bronze or Silver Item from your deck.
42010.Flavor: We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.
42010.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Alchemy card; or <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Item from your deck.

42011.Name: Priscilla
42011.Flavor: Picture Dandelion in a dress and you've got the general idea.

42012.Name: Vernon Roche
42012.Info:
Deploy: Deal 7 Damage to an enemy.
At the start of the game, add a Blue Stripes Commando to your deck.
42012.Flavor: A patriot… and a real pain in the rear.
42012.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
At the start of the game, add a Blue Stripes Commando to your deck.

42013.Name: Philippa Eilhart
42013.Info: Deploy: Deal 5 Damage to an enemy, then deal 4, 3, 2 and 1 Damage to random enemies.
42013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy, then deal 4, 3, 2 and 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to random enemies.

43001.Name: Thaler
43001.Info:
Spying. Single-Use.
Deploy: Look at 2 random cards from your deck.
Draw one and shuffle the other to your deck.
43001.Flavor: Piss off! We aren't all philanderers. Some of us have depth…
43001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>. <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random cards from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Draw</color> one and shuffle the other to your deck.

43002.Name: Ves
43002.Flavor: Better to live one day as a king than a whole life as a beggar.

43003.Name: Trollololo
43003.Info:
Every turn, on turn start, gain 2 Armor.
4 Armor.
43003.Flavor: Join me King Ravodid army. Order got – guard boatses.
43003.EnhancedInfo:
Every turn, on turn start, gain 2 Armor.
4 Armor.

43004.Name: Ronvid the Incessant
43004.Info:
On turn end, resurrect on a random row with 1 Power.
Crew.
43004.Flavor: This self-dubbed knight roams the world defending the honor of his beloved Maid Bilberry - though none are certain where she lives, if she lives still or if she ever lived at all.
43004.EnhancedInfo:
On turn end, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> on a random row with 1 <color=mycolor>Power</color>.
Crew.

43005.Name: Botchling
43005.Info: Deploy: Summon a Lubberkin on the same row.
43005.Flavor: Admit your mistakes and bury them proper – else they'll come back to haunt you.
43005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a Lubberkin on the same row.

43006.Name: Nenneke
43006.Info: Deploy: Return 3 Bronze or Silver units from the graveyard to your deck.
43006.Flavor: Few know more about healing than Nenneke.
43006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Return 3 Bronze or Silver units from the graveyard to your deck.

43007.Name: Foltest's Pride
43007.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy by 3 and move it to the row above.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.
43007.Flavor: As King Foltest likes to say, it's not size that counts, but whether it gets the job done.
43007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 3 and move it to the row above.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.

43008.Name: Vincent Meis
43008.Info: Deploy: Destroy the Armor of all units, then Boost self by half the value destroyed.
43008.Flavor: By day, Captain of the Vizima City Guard. By night, merciless avenger and defender of the downtrodden.
43008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy the Armor of all units, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by half the value destroyed.

43009.Name: Odrin
43009.Info:
On turn start, move to a random row and Boost all allies on it by 1.
Deathwish: Boost all allies on the same row by 1.
43009.Flavor: Drinkin' without Odrin is like rowin' without a paddle.
43009.EnhancedInfo:
On turn start, move to a random row and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all allies on it by 1.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all allies on the same row by 1.

43010.Name: Hubert Rejk
43010.Info: Deploy: Drain all Boosts from units in your deck.
43010.Flavor: The coroner is a calm, peaceful person. He even treats corpses with the utmost delicacy.
43010.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Drain all Boosts from units in your deck.

43011.Name: Margarita of Aretuza
43011.Info: Deploy: Reset a unit and toggle its Lock status.
43011.Flavor: I care only about what's good for Aretuza and my pupils.
43011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit and toggle its <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status.

43012.Name: Lubberkin
43012.Info: Deploy: Summon a Botchling on the same row.
43012.Flavor: I name thee Dea and embrace thee as my daughter.
43012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a Botchling on the same row.

43013.Name: Dethmold
43013.Info: Deploy: Spawn Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Alzur's Thunder.
43013.Flavor: I once made a prisoner vomit his own entrails… Ah, good times…
43013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Alzur's Thunder.

43014.Name: Síle de Tansarville
43014.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver special card from your hand, then draw a card.
43014.Flavor: The Lodge lacks humility. Our lust for power may yet be our undoing.
43014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver special card from your hand, then <color=mycolor>draw</color> a card.

43015.Name: Princess Pavetta
43015.Info: Deploy: Return each player's Lowest Bronze or Silver unit to their deck.
43015.Flavor: They said the queen was prone to outbursts, but I did not expect that…
43015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Return each player's Lowest Bronze or Silver unit to their deck.

43016.Name: Prince Stennis
43016.Info:
Deploy: Play a random non-Spying Bronze or Silver unit from your deck and give it 5 Armor.
3 Armor.
43016.Flavor: He wears armor made of gold. Of course he's a jerk.
43016.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> Bronze or Silver unit from your deck and give it 5 Armor.
3 Armor.

43017.Name: Sabrina Glevissig
43017.Info:
Spying.
Deathwish: Set the Power of all units on the row to the Power of the Lowest unit on the row.
43017.Flavor: The Daughter of the Kaedweni Wilderness.
43017.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
Deathwish: Set the <color=mycolor>Power</color> of all units on the row to the <color=mycolor>Power</color> of the Lowest unit on the row.

43018.Name: Sabrina: Inferno
43018.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze Cursed unit.
43018.Flavor: With her dying breath, Sabrina Glevissig cast a powerful curse that struck not only her executioners, but all who stood nearby.

43019.Name: Zoria Runestone
43019.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Northern Realms card.
43019.Flavor: I'm getting a palpable chill from this runestone… did I do something to hurt its feelings?
43019.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Northern Realms card.

43020.Name: Reinforcements
43020.Info: Play a Bronze or Silver Soldier, Machine, Officer or Support unit from your deck.
43020.Flavor: Sound the retreat! Regroup! And wait for reinforcements!
43020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Soldier, Machine, Officer or Support unit from your deck.

43021.Name: Vandergrift's Blade
43021.Info: Choose One: Destroy a Bronze or Silver Cursed enemy; or deal 10 Damage, If the unit was destroyed, Banish it.
43021.Flavor: Seltkirk shattered Vandergrift's sword during a knights' tourney in Ard Carraigh. Afterwards Vandergrift, enraged at his weapon's failure, ordered a new one forged, this time with powerful runestones enchanted into it.
43021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Destroy a Bronze or Silver Cursed enemy; or deal 10 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>, If the unit was destroyed, <color=mycolor>Banish</color> it.

44001.Name: Tridam Infantry
44001.Flavor: Soldiers loyal to the old baron of Tridam left the city with Falibor, thus becoming renegades wanted by the law.

44002.Name: Ban Ard Tutor
44002.Info: Deploy: Swap a card in your hand with a Bronze special card from your deck.
44002.Flavor: I'm constantly comparing the achievements of Aretuza's adepts with the work done by the lads at Ban Ard, and my conclusion constantly falls in favor of the girls.
44002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Swap</color> a card in your hand with a Bronze special card from your deck.

44003.Name: Kaedweni Sergeant
44003.Info:
Deploy: Clear Hazards from its row.
Crew.
3 Armor.
44003.Flavor: Forward, you sorry sods! Forward or you'll see the Nilfgaardians are the least of your worries!
44003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Clear Hazards from its row.
Crew.
3 Armor.

44004.Name: Kaedweni Cavalry
44004.Info: Deploy: Destroy a unit's Armor, then Boost self by the amount destroyed.
44004.Flavor: Always wondered – how the blazes do those lads handle nature's call…?
44004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy a unit's Armor, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by the amount destroyed.

44005.Name: Field Medic
44005.Flavor: Stitch red to red, white to white, and everything will be all right.

44006.Name: Redanian Elite
44006.Info:
Whenever this unit's Armor reaches 0, Boost self by 5.
4 Armor.
44006.Flavor: I'll die for Redania, I'll kill for Redania… I'll even eat worms for Redania!
44006.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever this unit's Armor reaches 0, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 5.
4 Armor.

44007.Name: Siege Tower
44007.Info:
Deploy: Boost self by 2.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.
44007.Flavor: The latest rage in assaults on walled cities.
44007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.

44008.Name: Reinforced Trebuchet
44008.Info: On turn end, deal 1 Damage to a random enemy.
44008.Flavor: Feel that? The earth trembles each time Big Bertha looses a stone.
44008.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.

44009.Name: Kaedweni Knight
44009.Info:
Deploy: If played from deck Boost self by 5.
2 Armor.
44009.Flavor: Not every man in the Kaedweni Army supports his king's politics. Yet not a single one would dare say that out loud.
44009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: If played from deck <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 5.
2 Armor.

44010.Name: Cursed Knight
44010.Info:
Deploy: Transform a Cursed ally into a base copy of this unit.
2 Armor.
44010.Flavor: He fights an endless war whose beginning he no longer remembers.
44010.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Transform</color> a Cursed ally into a base copy of this unit.
2 Armor.

44011.Name: Siege Support
44011.Info:
Whenever an ally appears, Boost it by 1.
If it's a Machine, also give it 1 Armor.
Crew.
44011.Flavor: You gotta recalibrate the arm by five degrees.\nDo what by the what now?
44011.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever an ally appears, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 1.
If it's a Machine, also give it 1 Armor.
Crew.

44012.Name: Redanian Knight
44012.Info: On turn end, if this unit has no Armor, Boost it by 2 and give it 2 Armor.
44012.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if this unit has no Armor, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2 and give it 2 Armor.

44013.Name: Redanian Knight-Elect
44013.Info:
On turn end, if this unit has Armor, Boost adjacent units by 1.
2 Armor.
44013.EnhancedInfo:
On turn end, if this unit has Armor, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> adjacent units by 1.
2 Armor.

44014.Name: Reinforced Ballista
44014.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy by 2.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.
44014.Flavor: Never manages to hit the same place twice, which, upon further reflection, might constitute a real problem.
44014.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 2.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.

44015.Name: Trebuchet
44015.Info:
Deploy: Damage 3 adjacent enemies by 1.
Crewed: Increase the Damage dealt by 1.
44015.Flavor: Castle won't batter itself down, now will it? Get them trebuchets rollin'!
44015.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> 3 adjacent enemies by 1.
Crewed: Increase the <color=mycolor>Damage</color> dealt by 1.

44016.Name: Aedirnian Mauler
44016.Info: Deploy: Damage an enemy by 4, if it survives Damage another by 2.
44016.Flavor: Ugh, these guys can be a real headache.
44016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 4, if it survives <color=mycolor>Damage</color> another by 2.

44017.Name: Ballista
44017.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy and up to 4 other random Enemies with the same Power by 1.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.
44017.Flavor: What crossbows want to be when they grow up.
44017.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy and up to 4 other random Enemies with the same <color=mycolor>Power</color> by 1.
Crewed: Repeat its ability.

44018.Name: Battering Ram
44018.Info:
Deploy: Deal 3 Damage.
If the unit was destroyed, deal 3 Damage to another unit.
Crewed: Increase initial Damage by 1.
44018.Flavor: Not gonna open up, eh? Guess we gotta knock harder.
44018.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>.
If the unit was destroyed, deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to another unit.
Crewed: Increase initial <color=mycolor>Damage</color> by 1.

44019.Name: Siege Master
44019.Info:
Deploy: Heal an allied Bronze or Silver Machine and repeat its ability.
Crew.
44019.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Heal an allied Bronze or Silver Machine and repeat its ability.
Crew.

44020.Name: Poor Fucking Infantry
44020.Info: Deploy: Spawn Left Flank Infantry and Right Flank Infantry to the left and right of this unit, respectively.
44020.Flavor: I's a war veteran! Spare me a crown?
44020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Left Flank Infantry and Right Flank Infantry to the left and right of this unit, respectively.

44021.Name: Reaver Hunter
44021.Info:
Deploy: Boost all copies of this unit by 1, if in hand, deck or on the board.
Repeat its ability whenever a copy of this unit is played.
44021.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all copies of this unit by 1, if in hand, deck or on the board.
Repeat its ability whenever a copy of this unit is played.

44022.Name: Temerian Drummer
44022.Flavor: Not the career he had in mind when he told mummy he wanted to be a musician.

44023.Name: Dun Banner Light Cavalry
44023.Info: On turn start, if you are losing by at least 26 points, Summon this unit on a random row.
44023.Flavor: Stay calm, everyone. And be alert. The true owners of those cloaks and beaver–skin caps might be elsewhere.
44023.EnhancedInfo: On turn start, if you are losing by at least 26 points, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> this unit on a random row.

44024.Name: Kaedweni Revenant
44024.Info:
When you play your next Spell or Item, Spawn a Doomed default copy of this unit on its row.
1 Armor.
44024.Flavor: Doomed to repeat the same day over and over again, just like the employees of Cianfanelli Bank.
44024.EnhancedInfo:
When you <color=mycolor>play</color> your next Spell or Item, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Doomed default copy of this unit on its row.
1 Armor.

44025.Name: Damned Sorceress
44025.Info:
Deploy: If there is a Cursed unit on this unit's row, deal 7 Damage.
Increase the Damage by 1 for each extra Cursed unit on the same row.
44025.Flavor: Sabrina's curse spared no one, not even her fellow practitioners.
44025.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: If there is a Cursed unit on this unit's row, deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>.
Increase the <color=mycolor>Damage</color> by 1 for each extra Cursed unit on the same row.

44026.Name: Aretuza Adept
44026.Info: Deploy: Play a random Bronze Hazard from your deck.
44026.Flavor: The adepts' every whim is catered to - they live like princesses at Aretuza. And in turn half the city lives off servicing them: seamstresses, milliners, confectioners, delivery boys…
44026.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> from your deck.

44027.Name: Blue Stripe Commando
44027.Info: Whenever a different Temerian ally with the same Power is played, Summon a copy of this unit from your deck on a random row.
44027.Flavor: I'd do anything for Temeria. Mostly though, I kill for her.
44027.EnhancedInfo: Whenever a different Temerian ally with the same <color=mycolor>Power</color> is played, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit from your deck on a random row.

44028.Name: Blue Stripe Scout
44028.Info:
Deploy: Boost all Temerian allies and your non-Spying Temerian units in hand and deck with the same Power as this unit by 1.
Crew.
44028.Flavor: Blue Stripes and Scoia'tael are similar in one regard – hatred fuels both.
44028.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Temerian allies and your non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> Temerian units in hand and deck with the same <color=mycolor>Power</color> as this unit by 1.
Crew.

44029.Name: Temerian Infantry
44029.Info: Deploy: Summon all copies of this unit on this row.
44029.Flavor: Temeria! Temeria! Gods shed all grace on thee! And smite thy foes with horrid woes, for all eternity!
44029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all copies of this unit on this row.

44030.Name: Witch Hunter
44030.Info:
Deploy: Reset a unit.
If it's a Mage, play another Witch Hunter from your deck.
44030.Flavor: Long coats, wide-brimmed hats, and crooked grins – witch hunters are hard to miss.
44030.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit.
If it's a Mage, <color=mycolor>play</color> another Witch Hunter from your deck.

44031.Name: Tormented Mage
44031.Info: Deploy: Look at 2 random Bronze Spells or Items from your deck, then play 1.
44031.Flavor: Prohibited? Yes. Eliminated? Far from it.
44031.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random Bronze Spells or Items from your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

44032.Name: Reaver Scout
44032.Info: Deploy: Choose a different Bronze ally and play a copy of it from your deck.
44032.Flavor: Haven't had much luck with monsters of late, so we enlisted.
44032.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a different Bronze ally and <color=mycolor>play</color> a copy of it from your deck.

44033.Name: Winch
44033.Info: Choose One: Resurrect a Bronze Machine and add the Doomed category to it; or Boost all Machines on your side of the board by 3.
44033.Flavor: It's a winch. Not much to flap your jaw about.
44033.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze Machine and add the Doomed category to it; or <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Machines on your side of the board by 3.

44034.Name: Bloody Flail
44034.Info:
Deal 5 Damage and Spawn a Specter on a random row.
(Specter; 5 Strength)
44034.EnhancedInfo:
Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> and <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Specter on a random row.
(Specter; 5 Strength)

51001.Name: Francesca Findabair
51001.Info: Deploy: Swap a card with one of your choice. Boost choosen card by 3.
51001.Flavor: Francesca Findabair's blue elven eyes were as impenetrable and hard as glass. When he was introduced to her, the Daisy of the Valleys smiled. The smile, though incredibly beautiful, filled the witcher with terror.
51001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Swap</color> a card with one of your choice. <color=mycolor>Boost</color> choosen card by 3.

51002.Name: Eithné
51002.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver special card.
51002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze or Silver special card.

51003.Name: Filavandrel
51003.Info: Deploy: Create a Silver special card.

51004.Name: Brouver Hoog
51004.Info: Deploy: Play a non-Spying Silver unit or a Bronze Dwarf from your deck.
51004.Flavor: That doddery dolt? Ye cannae even tell if he's alive or stuffed!
51004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> Silver unit or a Bronze Dwarf from your deck.

52001.Name: Saskia
52001.Info: Deploy: Swap up to 2 cards with Bronze cards.
52001.Flavor: I care not for kings and their titles. In the east lives one who truly deserves a crown.
52001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Swap</color> up to 2 cards with Bronze cards.

52002.Name: Saesenthessis
52002.Info: Deploy: Boost self by 1 for each Dwarf ally on the board and in your hand and deal 1 Damage for each Elf ally on the board and in your hand.
52002.Flavor: I inherited my father's ability to assume other forms - well, one other form, in my case.
52002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 for each Dwarf ally on the board and in your hand and deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> for each Elf ally on the board and in your hand.

52003.Name: Xavier Moran
52003.Info: Deploy: Boost this unit by the base Power of the highest base power Dwarf you played this round.
52003.Flavor: Well? Somethin' wrong? Venison a wee bit rank for ye? Ehh, princess?
52003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> this unit by the base <color=mycolor>Power</color> of the highest base <color=mycolor>power</color> Dwarf you played this round.

52004.Name: Aglaïs
52004.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver special card from your opponent's graveyard, then Banish it.
52004.Flavor: Brokilon bleeds… and not even I can heal it.
52004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze or Silver special card from your opponent's graveyard, then <color=mycolor>Banish</color> it.

52005.Name: Zoltan Chivay
52005.Info:
Deploy: Choose 3 units.
Strengthen allies by 2 and move them to this unit's row.
Damage enemies by 2 and move them to the opposite row.
52005.Flavor: Drinkin' alone's like crappin' with company.
52005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose 3 units.
<color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> allies by 2 and move them to this unit's row.
<color=mycolor>Damage</color> enemies by 2 and move them to the opposite row.

52006.Name: Isengrim Faoiltiarna
52006.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Ambush from your deck.
52006.Flavor: It dawns on them once they notice my scar: a realization of imminent death.
52006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver <color=mycolor>Ambush</color> from your deck.

52007.Name: Iorveth
52007.Info:
Deploy: Deal 8 Damage to an enemy.
If the unit was destroyed, Boost all loyal Elves in your hand by 1.
52007.Flavor: King or beggar, what's the difference? One dh'oine less.
52007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 8 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If the unit was destroyed, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all <color=mycolor>loyal</color> Elves in your hand by 1.

52008.Name: Milva
52008.Info: Deploy: Return each player's Highest Bronze or Silver unit to their deck.
52008.Flavor: With each arrow I loose, I think of my da. He'd be proud. I think.
52008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Return each player's Highest Bronze or Silver unit to their deck.

52009.Name: Morenn: Forest Child
52009.Info: Ambush: When your opponent plays a Bronze or Silver special card, flip over and cancel its effect.
52009.Flavor: I hold Brokilon dearer than my own life. She is a mother who cares for her children. I will defend her to my final breath.
52009.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Ambush</color>: When your opponent plays a Bronze or Silver special card, flip over and cancel its effect.

52010.Name: Schirrú
52010.Flavor: Time to look death in the face.

52011.Name: Ithlinne Aegli
52011.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze Spell, Boon or Hazard from your deck twice.
52011.Flavor: Famed for constantly prophesying the world's doom. Not much fun at parties.
52011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze Spell, <color=mycolor>Boon</color> or <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> from your deck twice.

52012.Name: Iorveth: Meditation
52012.Info: Deploy: Force 2 enemies on the same row to Duel each other.
52012.Flavor: Iorveth may have only one eye, but his inner vision is unmatched.
52012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Force 2 enemies on the same row to Duel each other.

52013.Name: Isengrim: Outlaw
52013.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Play a Bronze or Silver special card from your deck; or Create a Silver Elf.
52013.Flavor: Before us lies Elskerdeg Pass, and beyond that, Zerrikania and Hakland. Before us lies a long and dangerous road. If we are to walk it together… let us put aside our mistrust.
52013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver special card from your deck; or <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Silver Elf.

53001.Name: Yaevinn
53001.Info:
Spying. Single-Use.
Deploy: Look at a random special card and a random unit from your deck.
Draw one and shuffle the other to your deck.
53001.Flavor: We are the drops of rain that together make a ferocious storm.
53001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>. <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at a random special card and a random unit from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Draw</color> one and shuffle the other to your deck.

53002.Name: Ele'yas
53002.Info: Whenever you draw this unit or return it to your deck, Boost self by 2.
53002.Flavor: Love justifies madness in any of its forms.
53002.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you <color=mycolor>draw</color> this unit or return it to your deck, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

53003.Name: Ciaran aep Easnillen
53003.Info: Deploy: Toggle a unit's Lock status and move it to this unit's row on its side.
53003.Flavor: The path to freedom is paved in blood, not ink.
53003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle a unit's <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status and move it to this unit's row on its side.

53004.Name: Sheldon Skaggs
53004.Info: Deploy: Move all allies on this unit's row to random rows and Boost self by 1 for each.
53004.Flavor: I was there, on the front lines! Right where the fightin' was the thickest!
53004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move all allies on this unit's row to random rows and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 for each.

53005.Name: Dennis Cranmer
53005.Info: Deploy: Strengthen all your other Dwarves in hand, deck and on the board by 1.
53005.Flavor: I know how to execute orders, so take your advice somewhere else.
53005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> all your other Dwarves in hand, deck and on the board by 1.

53006.Name: Morenn
53006.Info: Ambush: When a unit is played from either hand on your opponent's side, flip over and deal 7 Damage to that unit.
53006.Flavor: Lady Eithné's daughter had inherited her sublime beauty and her wild hatred for all that is human.
53006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Ambush</color>: When a unit is played from either hand on your opponent's side, flip over and deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to that unit.

53007.Name: Yarpen Zigrin
53007.Info:
Whenever a Dwarf ally appears, Boost self by 1.
Resilience.
53007.Flavor: Ever hear o' the dragon Ocvist? From Quartz Mountain? Well, Yarpen Zigrin and his band o' dwarves did 'im in.
53007.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever a Dwarf ally appears, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.
<color=mycolor>Resilience</color>.

53008.Name: Malena
53008.Info: Ambush: After 2 turns, on turn start, flip over and Charm the Highest Bronze or Silver enemy with 5 Power or less.
53008.Flavor: I hate you, dh'oine. You are all the same.
53008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Ambush</color>: After 2 turns, on turn start, flip over and <color=mycolor>Charm</color> the Highest Bronze or Silver enemy with 5 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or less.

53009.Name: Aelirenn
53009.Info: When 5 Elven allies are on the board, Summon this unit on a random row.
53009.Flavor: Better to die standing than to live on bent knee.
53009.EnhancedInfo: When 5 Elven allies are on the board, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> this unit on a random row.

53010.Name: Braenn
53010.Info:
Deploy: Damage an enemy by this unit's power.
If the unit was destroyed, Boost all your other Dryads and Ambush units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.
53010.Flavor: Mona…? No… no. I'm Braenn. A daughter of Brokilon.
53010.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by this unit's <color=mycolor>power</color>.
If the unit was destroyed, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all your other Dryads and <color=mycolor>Ambush</color> units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.

53011.Name: Toruviel
53011.Info: Ambush: When your opponent passes, turn this unit over and Boost 2 units on each side by 2.
53011.Flavor: I'd gladly kill you from up close, stare in your eyes… But you reek, human.
53011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Ambush</color>: When your opponent passes, turn this unit over and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 2 units on each side by 2.

53012.Name: Pavko Gale
53012.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze or Silver Item from your deck.
53012.Flavor: No one smuggled as much food to the elves of the Blue Mountains as Gale. He'd bring them sacks of turnips and, prized most of all, leeks.
53012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Item from your deck.

53013.Name: Ida Emean aep Sivney
53013.Info: Deploy: Spawn Impenetrable Fog, Clear Skies or Alzur's Thunder.
53013.Flavor: I am a Sage. My power lies in possessing knowledge. Not sharing it.
53013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Impenetrable Fog, Clear Skies or Alzur's Thunder.

53014.Name: Milaen
53014.Info: Deploy: Deal 6 Damage to the units at the ends of an enemy row.
53014.Flavor: The old baron treated poachers mercilessly. Luckily for Milaen, the old baron was dead and his men, desperate outlaws.
53014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 6 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the units at the ends of an enemy row.

53015.Name: Éibhear Hattori
53015.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a lower or equal Bronze or Silver Scoia'tael unit.
53015.Flavor: Only thing that can rival his swords? His dumplings.
53015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a lower or equal Bronze or Silver Scoia'tael unit.

53016.Name: Paulie Dahlberg
53016.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a non-Support Bronze Dwarf.
53016.Flavor: Move yer arses! It's a ploughin' trap!

53017.Name: Barclay Els
53017.Info: Deploy: Play a random Bronze or Silver Dwarf from your deck and Strengthen it by 3.
53017.Flavor: Our mead smells rotten to ye, do it? Easy to fix – I'll break yer nose!
53017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze or Silver Dwarf from your deck and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3.

53018.Name: Morana Runestone
53018.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Scoia'tael card.
53018.Flavor: I grow faint at the very sight of it…
53018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Scoia'tael card.

53019.Name: Nature's Gift
53019.Info:
Play a Bronze or Silver special card from your deck.
Shuffle the others back.
53019.Flavor: To live in peace, we first must kill. This is human oppression's cruel finale.
53019.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver special card from your deck.
Shuffle the others back.

53020.Name: Pit Trap
53020.Info: Apply a Hazard to an enemy row that deals 3 Damage to units on contact.
53020.EnhancedInfo: Apply a <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> to an enemy row that deals 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to units on contact.

53021.Name: Mahakam Horn
53021.Info: Choose One: Create a Bronze or Silver Dwarf; or Strengthen a unit by 7.
53021.Flavor: Once upon a time, Mahakam held a horn-blowing contest. That day the dwarves made an important discovery: loud noises and snow-capped peaks do not play well together.
53021.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Dwarf; or <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> a unit by 7.

54001.Name: Vrihedd Sappers
54001.Info: Ambush: After 2 turns, on turn start, flip over.
54001.Flavor: No matter what you may have heard, elves don't take human scalps. Too much lice.
54001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Ambush</color>: After 2 turns, on turn start, flip over.

54002.Name: Elven Scout
54002.Flavor: They say elves leave no tracks in the snow, but if you ask me, they are just a pack of village idiots, babbling nonsense.

54003.Name: Vrihedd Neophyte
54003.Info: Deploy: Boost 2 random loyal units in your hand by 1.
54003.Flavor: Many nonhumans, fed up with the racism and xenophobia they encounter in the cities, decide to join the Scoia'tael.
54003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> 2 random <color=mycolor>loyal</color> units in your hand by 1.

54004.Name: Vrihedd Brigade
54004.Info: Deploy: Clear Hazards from its row and move a unit to this row on its side.
54004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Clear Hazards from its row and move a unit to this row on its side.

54005.Name: Dwarven Mercenary
54005.Info:
Deploy: Move a unit to this row on its side.
If it's an ally, Boost it by 3.
54005.Flavor: The key's mixin' pleasure an' business – like smackin' foes and gettin' coin for it.
54005.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move a unit to this row on its side.
If it's an ally, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 3.

54006.Name: Farseer
54006.Info: If a different ally or unit in your hand is Boosted during your turn, Boost self by 2 at the end of the turn.
54006.Flavor: Her words might seem unintelligible at times, but they always contain hidden meanings and tremendous wisdom.
54006.EnhancedInfo: If a different ally or unit in your hand is Boosted during your turn, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2 at the end of the turn.

54007.Name: Vrihedd Dragoon
54007.Info: On turn end, Boost a random loyal unit in your hand by 1.
54007.Flavor: Most terrible things I've witnessed? The Catriona plague, the razing of Vengerberg and the charge of the Vrihedd Dragoons.
54007.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random <color=mycolor>loyal</color> unit in your hand by 1.

54008.Name: Dol Blathanna Archer
54008.Info: Deploy: Deal 3 Damage, then deal 1 Damage.
54008.Flavor: Take another step, dh'oine. You'd look better with an arrow between your eyes.

54009.Name: Dol Blathanna Bowman
54009.Info:
Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to an enemy.
Whenever an enemy moves, deal 2 Damage to it.
Whenever this unit moves, deal 2 Damage to a random enemy.
54009.Flavor: You might manage to hide from them, but once spotted, don't bother trying to run.
54009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
Whenever an enemy moves, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to it.
Whenever this unit moves, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.

54010.Name: Hawker Smuggler
54010.Info: Whenever an enemy appears, Boost self by 1.
54010.Flavor: I fight for whoever's paying the best. Or whoever's easiest to rob.
54010.EnhancedInfo: Whenever an enemy appears, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.

54011.Name: Hawker Support
54011.Info: Deploy: Boost a unit in your hand by 3.
54011.Flavor: Elf, dwarf, makes no difference – long as they've got coin.
54011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a unit in your hand by 3.

54012.Name: Mahakam Marauder
54012.Info: Whenever this unit is Boosted, Damaged, Strengthened or Weakened, Boost it by 2.
54012.Flavor: Hunting on Mahakam's craggy cliffs is not particularly easy… but nor are dwarves particularly put off by danger.
54012.EnhancedInfo: Whenever this unit is Boosted, Damaged, Strengthened or Weakened, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2.

54013.Name: Vrihedd Vanguard
54013.Info:
Deploy: Boost Elf allies by 1.
Whenever you Swap this card, trigger its ability.
54013.Flavor: Temerians, Redanians, all the same. Better off dead.
54013.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> Elf allies by 1.
Whenever you <color=mycolor>Swap</color> this card, trigger its ability.

54014.Name: Dol Blathanna Bomber
54014.Info:
Deploy: Spawn an Incinerating Trap on an enemy row.
(Incinerating Trap; 1 Strength; Damage all units on this row by 2 on turn end)
54014.Flavor: They track like hounds, run like deer and kill like heartless demons.
54014.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> an Incinerating Trap on an enemy row.
(Incinerating Trap; 1 Strength; <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on this row by 2 on turn end)

54015.Name: Dwarven Skirmisher
54015.Info:
Deploy: Deal 3 Damage to an enemy.
If the unit was not destroyed, Boost self by 3.
54015.Flavor: Worked a pickaxe all me life. Battleaxe won't be any trouble.
54015.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy.
If the unit was not destroyed, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3.

54016.Name: Mahakam Defender
54016.Flavor: I'm telling ye, we're born fer battle – we slash straight at their knees!

54017.Name: Half-Elf Hunter
54017.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Doomed default copy of this unit.
54017.Flavor: Hated by men, reviled by elves and always picked last during schoolyard games. No wonder half-elves tend to have a chip on their shoulder.
54017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Doomed default copy of this unit.

54018.Name: Hawker Healer
54018.Info: Deploy: Boost 2 allies by 3, then Heal them.
54018.Flavor: Sure, I'll patch you up. Gonna cost you though.

54019.Name: Pyrotechnician
54019.Info: Deploy: Deal 3 Damage to a random enemy on each row.
54019.Flavor: An extraordinarily risky, and thus much revered, Mahakam trade. Its best-known practitioner was a dwarf by the name of Mikkel Bay.
54019.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy on each row.

54020.Name: Vrihedd Officer
54020.Info: Deploy: Swap a card and Boost self by its base Power.
54020.Flavor: Hatred burns brighter than any fire, and cuts deeper than any blade.
54020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Swap</color> a card and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

54021.Name: Elven Swordmaster
54021.Info: Deploy: Damage an enemy by this unit's Power.
54021.Flavor: Combat is a dance, and you must never allow your opponent to lead.

54022.Name: Mahakam Guard
54022.Flavor: Only one punishment for disturbin' the peace in Mahakam: a hammer to the heid.

54023.Name: Panther
54023.Info: Deploy: Deal 7 Damage to an enemy on a row with 3 or less units.
54023.Flavor: An Oxenfurt scholar once examined a panther and declared it was nothing more than a leopard of a different color. The panther seemed indifferent to this pronouncement and gobbled him up before he could complete his research.
54023.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy on a row with 3 or less units.

54024.Name: Wardancer
54024.Info: Whenever you Swap this unit, play it automatically on a random row.
54024.Flavor: You mean to say the she–elf danced amidst the fray? Have you lost your mind, corporal?!
54024.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you <color=mycolor>Swap</color> this unit, <color=mycolor>play</color> it automatically on a random row.

54025.Name: Blue Mountain Elite
54025.Info:
Deploy: Summon all copies of this unit on this row.
Whenever this unit moves, Boost self by 2.
54025.Flavor: By the time we'd heard them, it was already too late…
54025.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all copies of this unit on this row.
Whenever this unit moves, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

54026.Name: Mahakam Volunteers
54026.Info: Deploy: Summon all copies of this unit.
54026.Flavor: Hoooahhh! Hoooaahhh! Hooo! Prepare yer hineys, clowns! Soon we'll be comin' 'round! Tae kick 'em till ye've feet for frowns!

54027.Name: Dol Blathanna Sentry
54027.Info: If in hand, deck or on the board, Boost self by 1 whenever you play a special card.
54027.Flavor: As long as we stand, no human foot shall trample Dol Blathanna's meadows.
54027.EnhancedInfo: If in hand, deck or on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 whenever you <color=mycolor>play</color> a special card.

54028.Name: Sage
54028.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze Alchemy or Spell card, then Banish it.
54028.Flavor: Knowledge, my dear, is a privilege, and privileges are only shared among equals.
54028.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze Alchemy or Spell card, then <color=mycolor>Banish</color> it.

54029.Name: Dwarven Agitator
54029.Info: Deploy: Spawn a default copy of a random different Bronze Dwarf from your deck.
54029.Flavor: Mark me words, if ye dinnae get up off yer arses, humans're gonnae come here an' steal our wenches!
54029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a default copy of a random different Bronze Dwarf from your deck.

54030.Name: Elven Mercenary
54030.Info: Deploy: Look at 2 random Bronze special cards from your deck, then play 1.
54030.Flavor: I spit on Scoia'tael ideals, but not on their coin.
54030.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random Bronze special cards from your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> 1.

54031.Name: Elven Blade
54031.Info: Deal 10 Damage to a non-Elf unit.
54031.Flavor: Elven blades are light, yet deal heavy wounds.

54032.Name: Crushing Trap
54032.Info: Deal 6 Damage to the units at the ends of an enemy row.
54032.Flavor: When this knocks you down, you don't get up again.
54032.EnhancedInfo: Deal 6 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the units at the ends of an enemy row.

55001.Name: Incinerating Trap
55001.Info:
Spying.
Damage all units on this row by 2 on turn end.
55001.Flavor: Careful…! One more step and you'll be turned into molten glass.
55001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
<color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on this row by 2 on turn end.

61001.Name: Harald the Cripple
61001.Info: Deploy: Split 10 Damage randomly between enemies on the opposite row.
61001.Flavor: He did not stop until the islands were his and the head of the old jarl lay on the ground before him.
61001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Split 10 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> randomly between enemies on the opposite row.

61002.Name: Crach an Craite
61002.Info: Deploy: Strengthen the Highest non-Spying Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and play it.
61002.Flavor: Nilfgaardians call 'im Tirth ys Muire, the Wild Boar o' the Sea. Use 'im to scare their kiddies!
61002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> the Highest non-<color=mycolor>Spying</color> Bronze or Silver unit in your deck by 2 and <color=mycolor>play</color> it.

61003.Name: Eist Tuirseach
61003.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Bronze Clan Tuirseach Unit.
61003.Flavor: Eist came to Cintra to help Crach an Craite win the hand of Princess Pavetta, yet wound up winning her mother's heart for himself.

61004.Name: Bran Tuirseach
61004.Info: Deploy: Discard up to 3 cards from your deck and Strengthen them by 1.
61004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> up to 3 cards from your deck and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> them by 1.

62001.Name: Olaf
62001.Info:
Deploy: Deal 12 Damage to self.
Reduce the Damage inflicted by 2 for each Beast you played this match.
62001.Flavor: 10-time winner of the venerable title of Champion of the An Skellig Arena.
62001.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 12 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to self.
Reduce the <color=mycolor>Damage</color> inflicted by 2 for each Beast you played this match.

62002.Name: Hjalmar an Craite
62002.Info:
Deploy: Spawn the Lord of Undvik on the opposite row.
(Lord of Undvik; 5 Strength; Deathwish: Boost enemy Hjalmars by 14 and make them Immune.
62002.Flavor: Instead of mournin' the fallen, let's drink to their memory!
62002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> the Lord of Undvik on the opposite row.
(Lord of Undvik; 5 Strength; Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> enemy Hjalmars by 14 and make them Immune.

62003.Name: Vabjorn
62003.Info: Deploy: select an enemy, if it is damaged, destroy it, otherwise damage it by 2 until it is damaged and damage self by half strength.
62003.Flavor: Blood for Svalblod! Skulls for his throne!
62003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: select an enemy, if it is damaged, destroy it, otherwise <color=mycolor>damage</color> it by 2 until it is damaged and <color=mycolor>damage</color> self by half strength.

62004.Name: Ermion
62004.Info: Deploy: Draw 2 cards, then Discard 2 cards.
62004.Flavor: Only the ignorant dismiss the importance of myths.

62005.Name: Wild Boar of the Sea
62005.Info:
On turn end, Strengthen the unit to the left by 1, then deal 1 Damage to the unit to the right.
5 Armor.
62005.Flavor: Merely mention this name to a Nilfgaardian, and they'll feel a spreading warmth in their knickers…
62005.EnhancedInfo:
On turn end, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> the unit to the left by 1, then deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the unit to the right.
5 Armor.

62006.Name: Birna Bran
62006.Info: Deploy: Apply Skellige Storm to an enemy row.
62006.Flavor: Skellige must have a strong king. No matter what it takes.
62006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Apply Skellige Storm to an enemy row.

62007.Name: Cerys an Craite
62007.Info: When 4 units are resurrected while this unit is in the graveyard, resurrect it and Strengthen it by 1.
62007.Flavor: They call me Sparrowhawk. Know why? Because I eat rats like you for breakfast.
62007.EnhancedInfo: When 4 units are resurrected while this unit is in the graveyard, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> it and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 1.

62008.Name: Madman Lugos
62008.Info: Deploy: Discard a Bronze or Silver loyal unit from your deck and Damage an enemy by the Discarded unit's base Power.
62008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a Bronze or Silver <color=mycolor>loyal</color> unit from your deck and <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by the Discarded unit's base <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

62009.Name: Ulfhedinn
62009.Info:
Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to all enemies.
If the enemies were Damaged, deal 3 Damage instead.
62009.Flavor: Werewolf? Oh, no, no… this is something far, far worse.
62009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies.
If the enemies were Damaged, deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> instead.

62010.Name: Cerys: Fearless
62010.Info:
When you discard a Bronze or Silver unit, Damage self by 4 then resurrect it.
Repeat up to 1 time.
62010.Flavor: “If you want something done, send your best man. If you want something done right, send a woman.”
62010.EnhancedInfo:
When you <color=mycolor>discard</color> a Bronze or Silver unit, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> self by 4 then <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> it.
Repeat up to 1 time.

62011.Name: Coral
62011.Info:
Deploy: Transform a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine
(Jade Figurine; 2 Strength)
62011.Flavor: Her true name's Astrid Lyttneyd Ásgeirrfinnbjornsdottir, but that never fit on any forms.
62011.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Transform</color> a Bronze or Silver unit into a Jade Figurine
(Jade Figurine; 2 Strength)

62012.Name: Hym
62012.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Play a Bronze or Silver Cursed unit from your deck; or Create a Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck.
62012.Flavor: The gods' speak to me… I hear them whisper from the shadows…
62012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Cursed unit from your deck; or <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Silver unit from your opponent's starting deck.

62013.Name: Kambi
62013.Info:
Spying.
Deathwish: Spawn Hemdall.
(Hemdall; 20 Strength; Deploy: Destroy all units and clear all Boons and Hazards)
62013.Flavor: When the time comes, the cockerel Kambi shall crow and awaken Hemdall.
62013.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Hemdall.
(Hemdall; 20 Strength; <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy all units and clear all Boons and Hazards)

63001.Name: Jutta an Dimun
63001.Flavor: Some call her the Iron Maiden.

63002.Name: Udalryk
63002.Info:
Spying. Single-Use.
Deploy: Look at 2 random cards from your deck.
Draw one and Discard the other.
63002.Flavor: The gods have spoken: a sacrifice is required.
63002.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>. <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 random cards from your deck.
<color=mycolor>Draw</color> one and <color=mycolor>Discard</color> the other.

63003.Name: Djenge Frett
63003.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to 2 allies and Strengthen self by 2 for each.
63003.Flavor: When a warrant says dead or alive, most bounty hunters'll just kill you. Not me. Should I catch you, you'll hang, and I'll tickle your feet as you expire.
63003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 2 allies and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 2 for each.

63004.Name: Blueboy Lugos
63004.Info:
Deploy: Spawn a Spectral Whale on an enemy row.
(Spectral Whale; 3 Strength; On turn end, move to a random row and deal 1 Damage to all units on it. Deathwish: Deal 1 damage to all units on this row)
63004.Flavor: I'm near ready to puke from boredom.
63004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Spectral Whale on an enemy row.
(Spectral Whale; 3 Strength; On turn end, move to a random row and deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units on it. Deathwish: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>damage</color> to all units on this row)

63005.Name: Morkvarg
63005.Info: Whenever this unit enters the graveyard, resurrect it and Weaken it by half.
63005.Flavor: The vilest man Skellige's ever known.
63005.EnhancedInfo: Whenever this unit enters the graveyard, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> it and Weaken it by half.

63006.Name: Svanrige Tuirseach
63006.Info: Deploy: Draw a card, then Discard a card.
63006.Flavor: The emperor also thought him an accidental king. At first.

63007.Name: Donar an Hindar
63007.Info: Deploy: Toggle a unit's Lock status, then move a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard to yours.
63007.Flavor: I've gathered all the jarls together. Now make your case.
63007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Toggle a unit's <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status, then move a Bronze unit from your opponent's graveyard to yours.

63008.Name: Giant Boar
63008.Info: Deploy: Destroy a random ally, then Boost self by 10.
63008.Flavor: Most men, seeing a massive boar in the woods, mess their trousers and scurry up the nearest tree. A Skelliger, though - he just drools.
63008.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy a random ally, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 10.

63009.Name: Champion of Hov
63009.Flavor: At close range, trolls never use weapons. And why would they?

63010.Name: Draig Bon-Dhu
63010.Info: Deploy: Strengthen 2 units in your graveyard by 3.
63010.Flavor: Hear ye now the tale of the heroic deeds of Clan an Craite.

63011.Name: Holger Blackhand
63011.Info:
Deploy: Deal 7 Damage.
If the unit was destroyed, Strengthen the Highest unit in your graveyard by 3.
63011.Flavor: Now let's drink to the Emperor of Nilfgaard – may he die of somethin' hideous!
63011.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>.
If the unit was destroyed, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> the Highest unit in your graveyard by 3.

63012.Name: Harald Houndsnout
63012.Info:
Deploy: Spawn Wilfred to the left, Wilhelm to the right and Wilmar on the opposite row.
(Deathwish: Strengthen a random ally by 3)
(Deathwish: Damage all units on the opposite row by 1)
(Deathwish: Spawn a Bear on the opposite row).
(Bear; 11 Strength)
63012.Flavor: Once proud jarl of Clan Tordarroch, now a muttering madman.
63012.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Wilfred to the left, Wilhelm to the right and Wilmar on the opposite row.
(Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> a random ally by 3)
(Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on the opposite row by 1)
(Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bear on the opposite row).
(Bear; 11 Strength)

63013.Name: Yoana
63013.Info: Deploy: Heal an ally, then Boost it by the amount Healed.
63013.Flavor: No one'd ever think I could be a skilled armorer - a human, and a woman to boot. A dwarven blacksmith - that's another story…
63013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Heal an ally, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by the amount Healed.

63014.Name: Derran
63014.Info: Whenever an enemy is Damaged, Boost this unit by 1.
63014.Flavor: Whatever caused this madness must have been terrifying…
63014.EnhancedInfo: Whenever an enemy is Damaged, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> this unit by 1.

63015.Name: Skjall
63015.Info: Deploy: Play a random Bronze or Silver Cursed unit from your deck.
63015.Flavor: Strike his name from the Saga of Elders! No one dare grant him shelter or sustenance!
63015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze or Silver Cursed unit from your deck.

63016.Name: Gremist
63016.Info: Deploy: Spawn Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Bloodcurdling Roar.
63016.Flavor: An archdruid, a master of alchemy, and the grumpiest old fart in the Isles.
63016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Torrential Rain, Clear Skies or Bloodcurdling Roar.

63017.Name: Sigrdrifa
63017.Info: Deploy: Resurrect a Bronze or Silver Skellige unit.
63017.Flavor: Fall on your knees and beg Modron Freya for forgiveness.
63017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze or Silver Skellige unit.

63018.Name: Stribog Runestone
63018.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Skellige card.
63018.Flavor: Ofieri runemasters can combine these into runewords of incredible power.
63018.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Skellige card.

63019.Name: Restore
63019.Info: Return a Bronze or Silver Skellige unit from your graveyard to your hand, add the Doomed category to it, and set its base Power to 8, then play a card.
63019.Flavor: Those cursed sorceresses are stealing our thunder! Whyever should folk choose a procedure taking several hours, when some perfumed tart can solve their problem with a wave of her hand?
63019.EnhancedInfo: Return a Bronze or Silver Skellige unit from your graveyard to your hand, add the Doomed category to it, and set its base <color=mycolor>Power</color> to 8, then <color=mycolor>play</color> a card.

63020.Name: Ornamental Sword
63020.Info: Create a Bronze or Silver Skellige Soldier and Strengthen it by 3.
63020.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Create</color> a Bronze or Silver Skellige Soldier and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3.

64001.Name: An Craite Warrior
64001.Flavor: Our clan's bards will sing of my deeds long after you're dead and forgotten!

64002.Name: Dimun Pirate
64002.Info: Deploy: Discard all copies of this unit from your deck.
64002.Flavor: Can see the fear in their eyes. Fear o' me… fear o' Clan Dimun!
64002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> all copies of this unit from your deck.

64003.Name: Heymaey Flaminica
64003.Info: Deploy: Clear Hazards from its row and move 2 allies to it.
64003.Flavor: A flaminica, the highest position among the druidesses, commands a great deal of respect and wields a great deal of power.
64003.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Clear Hazards from its row and move 2 allies to it.

64004.Name: Dimun Smuggler
64004.Info: Deploy: Return one Bronze unit from your graveyard to your deck.
64004.Flavor: Spikeroog's a barren backwater, but that don't bother us - everythin' we need, we take from you.
64004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Return one Bronze unit from your graveyard to your deck.

64005.Name: Berserker Marauder
64005.Info: Deploy: Boost self by 1 for each Damaged ally and by 1 for each Cursed ally.
64005.Flavor: Mercenaries fight for coin. Knights duel for honor. He kills for blood.
64005.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 for each Damaged ally and by 1 for each Cursed ally.

64006.Name: Heymaey Skald
64006.Info: Deploy: Boost all allies from a Clan of your choice by 1.
64006.Flavor: The deeds of Clan Heymaey will go down in history.
64006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all allies from a Clan of your choice by 1.

64007.Name: An Craite Blacksmith
64007.Info: Deploy: Strengthen an ally by 2 and give it 2 Armor.
64007.Flavor: Remember me words – a good shield can save yer life.
64007.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> an ally by 2 and give it 2 Armor.

64008.Name: Savage Bear
64008.Info: Whenever a unit is played from either hand on your opponent's side of the board, deal 1 Damage to it.
64008.Flavor: Tame? Och, lad, Skelligers might train bears, but that don't at all mean they tame 'em…
