64008.EnhancedInfo: Whenever a unit is played from either hand on your opponent's side of the board, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to it.

64009.Name: An Craite Greatsword
64009.Info: Every 2 turns, on turn start, if Damaged, Heal self and Strengthen by 2.
64009.Flavor: Ahh, ye gave me a good laugh there, Nordling! Why, this bastard, ye couldn't even grip it, let alone gut me with it.
64009.EnhancedInfo: Every 2 turns, on turn start, if Damaged, Heal self and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> by 2.

64010.Name: Tuirseach Archer
64010.Flavor: So ye can hit a movin' target at two hundred paces? Me, too. In a storm.

64011.Name: Drummond Warmonger
64011.Info: Deploy: Discard a Bronze card from your deck.
64011.Flavor: Think o' the greater good?! War's the greatest good, the greatest bad, the greatest damn anythin' man's ever come up with!
64011.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a Bronze card from your deck.

64012.Name: Tuirseach Skirmisher
64012.Info: Whenever this unit is resurrected, Strengthen it by 4.
64012.Flavor: Friends we show heart, foes we show our axe. Remember that.
64012.EnhancedInfo: Whenever this unit is resurrected, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 4.

64013.Name: Svalblod Ravager
64013.Info:
Whenever this unit is Damaged or Weakened, transform into a Raging Bear.
(Raging Bear; 13 Strength)
64013.Flavor: A two-handed axe? Seems no one told him that.
64013.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever this unit is Damaged or Weakened, <color=mycolor>transform</color> into a Raging Bear.
(Raging Bear; 13 Strength)

64014.Name: An Craite Whaler
64014.Info: Deploy: Move an enemy to the opposite row, then deal Damage equal to the number of units on that row.
64014.Flavor: Skelligers have long known that harpoons are effective against more than mere whales...
64014.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move an enemy to the opposite row, then deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> equal to the number of units on that row.

64015.Name: An Craite Armorsmith
64015.Info: Deploy: Heal 2 allies and give them 3 Armor.
64015.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Heal 2 allies and give them 3 Armor.

64016.Name: Tuirseach Veteran
64016.Info: Deploy: Strengthen all your other Clan Tuirseach units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.
64016.Flavor: In my days I've seen wonders no man's ever dreamt of, and done things no man should ever do.
64016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> all your other Clan Tuirseach units in hand, deck and on the board by 1.

64017.Name: Dimun Light Longship
64017.Info: On turn end, deal 1 Damage to the unit to the right, then Boost self by 2.
64017.Flavor: Escape them? In the waters of Skellige? Good luck.
64017.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the unit to the right, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

64018.Name: An Craite Longship
64018.Info:
Deploy: Deal 2 Damage to a random enemy.
Repeat its ability whenever you Discard a card.
64018.Flavor: They say Hemdall's heart swells whenever the longships sail out on a raid.
64018.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.
Repeat its ability whenever you <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a card.

64019.Name: Dimun Warship
64019.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to the same unit 4 times.
64019.Flavor: Clan Dimun warships are light and fast, perfect for racing down slow merchant frigates.
64019.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the same unit 4 times.

64020.Name: An Craite Marauder
64020.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage.
If resurrected, deal 6 Damage instead.
64020.Flavor: You daft? You mean to sail to Skellige? Those barbarians'll tear you to shreds!

64021.Name: Tuirseach Hunter
64021.Flavor: Better believe we can hunt. Thing is, not much game on Spikeroog…

64022.Name: Tuirseach Axeman
64022.Info:
Whenever an enemy on the opposite row is Damaged, Boost self by 1.
2 Armor.
64022.Flavor: Swords are for wenches. Get yourself an axe.
64022.EnhancedInfo:
Whenever an enemy on the opposite row is Damaged, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.
2 Armor.

64023.Name: An Craite Warcrier
64023.Info: Deploy: Boost an ally by half its Power.
64023.Flavor: Every man, woman and child in Skellige can split a foe with an axe. Only a select few can split enemy ears with a rage-filled cry.

64024.Name: An Craite Raider
64024.Info: Whenever you Discard this unit, resurrect it on a random row.
64024.Flavor: Man or tree, a Skelligan axe fells it all the same.
64024.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you <color=mycolor>Discard</color> this unit, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> it on a random row.

64025.Name: Drummond Queensguard
64025.Info: Deploy: Resurrect all your copies of this unit.
64025.Flavor: The queen is guarded by the hardiest and fiercest shieldmaidens Skellige's ever known.
64025.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> all your copies of this unit.

64026.Name: Drummond Shieldmaiden
64026.Info:
Deploy: Deal 2 Damage.
If the unit was already Damaged, play a copy of this unit from your deck.
64026.Flavor: They'll shatter on our shields like waves on a craggy shore.
64026.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>.
If the unit was already Damaged, <color=mycolor>play</color> a copy of this unit from your deck.

64027.Name: Heymaey Herbalist
64027.Info: Deploy: Play a random Bronze Organic or Hazard card from your deck.
64027.Flavor: We don't burn cunning women in Skellige - we take their advice.
64027.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze Organic or <color=mycolor>Hazard</color> card from your deck.

64028.Name: Dimun Corsair
64028.Flavor: The sea's ours, along with everythin' that floats, swims or sails in it!

64029.Name: Heymaey Spearmaiden
64029.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to a Machine or Soldier ally, then play a copy of it from your deck.
64029.Flavor: Skellige women are wild and unpredictable. All units are to treat them as serious threats and never underestimate their capabilities. - General Directive to the Invading Forces of the Imperial Armada
64029.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a Machine or Soldier ally, then <color=mycolor>play</color> a copy of it from your deck.

64030.Name: Heymaey Protector
64030.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze Item from your deck.
64030.Flavor: He fears nothing save Freya's wrath... and his wife's.
64030.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze Item from your deck.

64031.Name: Dimun Pirate Captain
64031.Info: Deploy: Play a different Bronze Dimun unit from your deck.
64031.Flavor: Haul together, hoist the colors high!
64031.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a different Bronze Dimun unit from your deck.

64032.Name: Priestess of Freya
64032.Flavor: Modron Freya, the Great Mother, is the goddess of love, beauty and bounty.

64033.Name: Tuirseach Bearmaster
64033.Flavor: Don't touch him. Don't look him in the eyes. In fact… don't go anywhere near him.

64034.Name: Bone Talisman
64034.Info: Choose One: Resurrect a Bronze Beast or Cultist; or Heal an ally and Strengthen it by 3.
64034.Flavor: The simplest of objects sometimes possess the greatest power.
64034.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> a Bronze Beast or Cultist; or Heal an ally and <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> it by 3.

65001.Name: Hemdall
65001.Info: Deploy: Destroy all units and clear all Boons and Hazards.
65001.Flavor: When the time of the White Frost comes, Hemdall will sound the call for battle.
65001.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy all units and clear all Boons and Hazards.

65002.Name: Raging Bear
65002.Flavor: We're going on a bear hunt! We're going to catch a–– THAT THING'S HUGE! RUN!

65003.Name: Lord of Undvik
65003.Info:
Spying.
Deathwish: Boost enemy Hjalmars by 14 and make them Immune.
65003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> enemy Hjalmars by 14 and make them Immune.

65004.Name: Spectral Whale
65004.Info:
Spying.
On turn end, move to a random row and deal 1 Damage to all units on it.
Deathwish: Deal 1 damage to all units on this row.
65004.Flavor: Ehh, too big for a humpback. That's a finback. A finback? With a snout that short? Those herbs've gone to your head!
65004.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
On turn end, move to a random row and deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all units on it.
Deathwish: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>damage</color> to all units on this row.

65005.Name: Wilfred
65005.Info: Deathwish: Strengthen a random ally by 3.

65006.Name: Wilhelm
65006.Info: Deathwish: Damage all units on the opposite row by 1.
65006.EnhancedInfo: Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on the opposite row by 1.

65007.Name: Wilmar
65007.Info:
Spying.
Deathwish: If its opponent turn, Spawn a Bear on the opposite row.
(Bear; 11 Strength)
65007.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
Deathwish: If its opponent turn, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bear on the opposite row.
(Bear; 11 Strength)

70001.Name: Quen
70001.Info: Choose a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand, then Boost it and all its copies in your hand and deck by 2 and give them Shield. The Shield can block any Damage once.
70001.EnhancedInfo: Choose a Bronze or Silver unit in your hand, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it and all its copies in your hand and deck by 2 and give them Shield. The Shield can block any <color=mycolor>Damage</color> once.

70002.Name: Detlaff: Higher Vampire
70002.Info: Deploy: Choose a Bronze unit in your deck. If it has more Power than this unit, consume it and boost self by its power. Otherwise, play that unit and send it to the graveyard at the end of the turn.
70002.Flavor: In his true form, the Beast of Beauclair could cause even a witcher to quake in his boots.
70002.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a Bronze unit in your deck. If it has more <color=mycolor>Power</color> than this unit, consume it and <color=mycolor>boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>power</color>. Otherwise, <color=mycolor>play</color> that unit and send it to the graveyard at the end of the turn.

70003.Name: Hammond
70003.Info:
Deploy, Choose One: Spawn a Skellige Bronze Machine; or Boost all allied Machines on the board by 2.
Units in this row are Immune to Damage from Hazards.
70003.Flavor: Once mistaken for a whale calf and nearly harpooned. He's avoided swimming ever since.
70003.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Skellige Bronze Machine; or <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all allied Machines on the board by 2.
Units in this row are Immune to <color=mycolor>Damage</color> from Hazards.

70004.Name: Glynnis aep Loernach
70004.Info: On turn end, if at the top or bottom of the deck, Summon it on a random row.
70004.Flavor: She loved every soldier like a son. She cried for each one.
70004.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if at the top or bottom of the deck, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> it on a random row.

70005.Name: Vysogota Of Corvo
70005.Info:
On round start, if there is a unit to the right Boost it by 3, then Damage self by 1 and move to the friendly row with the least amount of units.
Deathwish: Boost the Lowest ally by 6.
70005.Flavor: It's been near half a century since I last practiced medicine. The years haven't been kind to my memory... Nor the dexterity of my fingers.
70005.EnhancedInfo:
On round start, if there is a unit to the right <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 3, then <color=mycolor>Damage</color> self by 1 and move to the friendly row with the least amount of units.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Lowest ally by 6.

70006.Name: Lady Of The Lake
70006.Info: Deploy: Weaken self by 2 for every card in your hand and deck.
70006.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Weaken self by 2 for every card in your hand and deck.

70007.Name: Prophet Lebioda
70007.Info: When Banished, Boost all allies by 1.
70007.Flavor: To thine own self be judge and ruler for thou alone shalt answer for thine deeds before thee.

70008.Name: Vivienne: Oriole
70008.Info:
Single-Use.
On turn end, if your total Power exceeds the opponent's Power by at least 26 points, return to your hand.
70008.Flavor: Who'd not like to live free as a bird? Well, just ask Vivienne de Tabris.
70008.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
On turn end, if your total <color=mycolor>Power</color> exceeds the opponent's <color=mycolor>Power</color> by at least 26 points, return to your hand.

70009.Name: Fleder
70009.Info:
Deploy: Summon a copy of this unit from your deck on its right.
Whenever a Bronze or Silver enemy becomes Damaged, Boost self by 1.
70009.Flavor: The children o' the night come as punishment from the gods! We's tolerated wizard-folk and non-human filth in our midst too long! Repent! 'Fore yer soul rots, repent!
70009.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit from your deck on its right.
Whenever a Bronze or Silver enemy becomes Damaged, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1.

70010.Name: Protofleder
70010.Info:
Deploy: Add a Fleder to the top of your deck.
Whenever a Bronze or Silver enemy becomes Damaged, Boost self by 2.
70010.Flavor: Limited to only one region of the Continent, scholars consider them critically endangered. Gods be praised...
70010.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Add a Fleder to the top of your deck.
Whenever a Bronze or Silver enemy becomes Damaged, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 2.

70011.Name: Lady Of The Lake: Advent
70011.Info:
Spawn Lady Of The Lake.
(Lady of The Lake; 25 Power; Deploy: Weaken self by 2 for every card in your hand and deck.)
70011.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Lady Of The Lake.
(Lady of The Lake; 25 <color=mycolor>Power</color>; <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Weaken self by 2 for every card in your hand and deck.)

70012.Name: Toussaint Knight-Errant
70012.Info: Deploy: For each card advantage your opponent has, Boost self by 4.
70012.Flavor: White steed, shiny-arse armor... Aye, 'tis a knight-errant alright. Fetch the coffin maker!
70012.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: For each card advantage your opponent has, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 4.

70013.Name: Corrupted Flaminca
70013.Info: Deploy: Discard a torrential rain from deck and apply a torrential rain on both sides, if there are no torrential rains in your deck, weaken self by 4 and apply Torrential Rain on both sides.
70013.Flavor: At times, even druids succumb to Svalblod's whispers...
70013.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a torrential rain from deck and apply a torrential rain on both sides, if there are no torrential rains in your deck, weaken self by 4 and apply Torrential Rain on both sides.

70014.Name: The Goddess of Justice
70014.Info:
Bid for the Red Coin.
Choose how many points you are willing to give up to start the game second. At the end of the first round, this card is Summoned to Blue Coin player's board from the graveyard.
70014.EnhancedInfo:
Bid for the Red Coin.
Choose how many points you are willing to give up to start the game second. At the end of the first round, this card is Summoned to Blue Coin player's board from the graveyard.

70015.Name: Brokilon Sentinel
70015.Info: On turn end, if the opponent has exactly 4 units in the opposing row, deal 1 Damage to all enemies in that row.
70015.Flavor: Brokilon is not merely the forest you see before you. She yet lives on in the cities, villages, and fields you so callously carved from her flesh. We shall yet reclaim what you have stolen from her.
70015.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if the opponent has exactly 4 units in the opposing row, deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to all enemies in that row.

70016.Name: Sukrus
70016.Info: Deploy: Choose a Bronze card in your hand and Discard all copies of it from your deck.
70016.Flavor: One of many who sought fortune in Novigrad. And one of many more who never found it.
70016.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a Bronze card in your hand and <color=mycolor>Discard</color> all copies of it from your deck.

70017.Name: Cintrian Enchantress
70017.Info: Deploy: Shuffle a non-Support Bronze ally back to your deck, then play a random Bronze unit from your deck.
70017.Flavor: The ladies of the Cintrian court are oft touted for their stately elegance – and equally impressive aptitude for magic
70017.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Shuffle a non-Support Bronze ally back to your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> a random Bronze unit from your deck.

70019.Name: Zoltan: Warrior
70019.Info:
Deploy: Summon Figgis Merluzzo and Munro Bruys on this row.
Strengthen self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.
70019.Flavor: I've decided to do tangible good, that is not wasted. I am good to myself and my immediate surroundings.
70019.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Figgis Merluzzo and Munro Bruys on this row.
<color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.

70020.Name: Figgis Merluzzo
70020.Info:
Deploy: Summon Zoltan Warrior and Munro Bruys on this row.
Strengthen self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.
70020.Flavor: I'm a simple guy. I like drinking, eating, singing lewd songs… And when the party dies down, pissing on the dying bonfire.
70020.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Zoltan Warrior and Munro Bruys on this row.
<color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.

70021.Name: Munro Bruys
70021.Info:
Deploy: Summon Zoltan: Warrior and Figgis Merluzzo on this row.
Strengthen self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.
70021.Flavor: Munro dreamed of building steam and water-powered hammerworks. But he ended up as bouncer at the worst bar in Vizima…
70021.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> Zoltan: Warrior and Figgis Merluzzo on this row.
<color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 1 whenever this unit is Strengthened.

70022.Name: Kikimore Worker
70022.Info: Deploy: Boost all Insectoid allies on the same row by 2.
70022.Flavor: They say it can eat a whole man in armor down to the bone in less than a minute. I'd rather not find out if it's true.
70022.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all Insectoid allies on the same row by 2.

70023.Name: Kikimore Warrior
70023.Info: Deploy: Consume a different Bronze unit in your deck with current Power no greater than its own, then Boost self by its Power.
70023.Flavor: Come spring, the buggers start to burst through the woodwork. Literally.
70023.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Consume a different Bronze unit in your deck with current <color=mycolor>Power</color> no greater than its own, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by its <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

70024.Name: Immortals
70024.Info:
When an adjacent Cursed unit is destroyed, Spawn a Specter on this row, then damage self by 1.
(Specter; 5 Strength)
70024.Flavor: Where one falls, another will take his place.
70024.EnhancedInfo:
When an adjacent Cursed unit is destroyed, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Specter on this row, then <color=mycolor>damage</color> self by 1.
(Specter; 5 Strength)

70025.Name: Syanna
70025.Info:
Single-Use.
Repeat the Deploy ability of the next Bronze or Silver loyal unit you play.
4 Armor.
70025.Flavor: Your Majesty... The princess has been touched by the curse o' the Black Sun. There's no hope, I'm afraid...
70025.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
Repeat the <color=mycolor>Deploy</color> ability of the next Bronze or Silver <color=mycolor>loyal</color> unit you <color=mycolor>play</color>.
4 Armor.

70026.Name: Ivo of Belhaven
70026.Info:
On turn start, if you are winning, Strengthen self by 2.
Deathwish: Move a random Witcher in your deck to the top of your deck.
70026.Flavor: It's not reason I'm devoid of, just emotion.
70026.EnhancedInfo:
On turn start, if you are winning, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 2.
Deathwish: Move a random Witcher in your deck to the top of your deck.

70027.Name: Geralt: Axii
70027.Info: Deploy: Replay a Bronze or Silver loyal unit from your opponent's side of the board, then move it back to the opposite row.
70027.Flavor: Placing his left arm around the horse's neck, Geralt makes the Axii sign with the fingers of his right hand above the steed's head and whispers the incantation.
70027.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Replay a Bronze or Silver <color=mycolor>loyal</color> unit from your opponent's side of the board, then move it back to the opposite row.

70032.Name: Gascon
70032.Info:
Deploy: Choose a row, move all units on both sides of it to random rows and Damage self by 2 for each unit moved.
When in your hand or deck, Boost self by 1 whenever a unit moves during your turn.
70032.Flavor: Th' Strays of Spalla – 'tis you who lead them? 'Tis you they call the Duke of Dogs?
70032.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose a row, move all units on both sides of it to random rows and <color=mycolor>Damage</color> self by 2 for each unit moved.
When in your hand or deck, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 1 whenever a unit moves during your turn.

70033.Name: War Elephant
70033.Info: Deploy: Destroy the Armor of self and adjacent units, then Damage a unit by the amount destroyed.
70033.Flavor: It's kind of like a fiend, but bald and with a nose that hangs to the ground. What? No, you're making things up!
70033.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy the Armor of self and adjacent units, then <color=mycolor>Damage</color> a unit by the amount destroyed.

70038.Name: Sigvald
70038.Info: On turn end, resurrect on a random row and strengthen self by 1. Its base strength cannot be over 10.
70038.Flavor: A vildkaarl that lives to old age earns the respect of his clan.
70038.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> on a random row and <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> self by 1. Its base strength cannot be over 10.

70039.Name: Terror Crew
70039.Info: Deal 4 Damage to a random enemy. When Discarded, trigger its ability and add 1 Terror Crew Plunderers to your deck. (10 Str; Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to a random enemy. When Discarded, trigger its ability and add a copy of this card to the bottom of your deck)
70039.EnhancedInfo: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy. When Discarded, trigger its ability and add 1 Terror Crew Plunderers to your deck. (10 Str; <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy. When Discarded, trigger its ability and add a copy of this card to the bottom of your deck)

70040.Name: Terror Crew Plunderer
70040.Info:
Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to a random enemy.
When Discarded, trigger its ability and add a copy of this card to the bottom of your deck.
70040.Flavor: They say diamonds are a girl's best friend. But my best friend is a knife. I can use it to get anything else I want.
70040.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.
When Discarded, trigger its ability and add a copy of this card to the bottom of your deck.

70041.Name: Giga Scorpion Decoction
70041.Info:
Damage the strongest enemy by 2.
Repeat 3 times.
For each White Raffard's Decoction in your graveyard, repeat once more.
70041.Flavor: How much of a dose would be lethal? Any.
70041.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Damage</color> the strongest enemy by 2.
Repeat 3 times.
For each White Raffard's Decoction in your graveyard, repeat once more.

70042.Name: White Raffard's Decoction
70042.Info:
Boost the weakest ally by 2.
Repeat 3 times.
For each Giga Scorpion Decoction in your graveyard, repeat once more.
70042.Flavor: It is the duchess's exclusive privilege to delight in the prized, oaky flavor of Sangreal... A pleasure she partakes in very, very often.
70042.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Boost</color> the weakest ally by 2.
Repeat 3 times.
For each Giga Scorpion Decoction in your graveyard, repeat once more.

70043.Name: Vernossiel's Commando
70043.Info: After you Swap this unit 2 times, Summon it on a random row.
70043.Flavor: Only a swish could be heard... Followed by six men tumbling dead to the ground.
70043.EnhancedInfo: After you <color=mycolor>Swap</color> this unit 2 times, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> it on a random row.

70044.Name: Vernossiel
70044.Info: Deploy: Add 2 Vernossiel's Commandos to your deck and reduce their counter by 1.
70044.Flavor: It turns out that the forest isn't inhabited by, to quote the captain of the guard, some furry fucking thing, but Scoia'tael commandos. They were led by someone named Vernossiel…
70044.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Add 2 Vernossiel's Commandos to your deck and reduce their counter by 1.

70045.Name: Meve
70045.Info:
Deploy: Boost a unit on your side of the board, in your hand and in your deck each by 4.
Crew.
70045.Flavor: We're at war, when rulers don't strive nor choose. When rulers grasp sword and shield and ride out to defend their subjects.
70045.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a unit on your side of the board, in your hand and in your deck each by 4.
Crew.

70046.Name: Svalblod Fanatic
70046.Info: On turn end, deal 3 Damage to the Lowest enemy, then deal 3 Damage to self.
70046.Flavor: Not all are worthy of Svalblod's blessing.
70046.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to the Lowest enemy, then deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to self.

70050.Name: Mad Charge
70050.Info: Choose an ally with Armor, that unit then Duels chosen enemy.
70050.Flavor: You can't stop a galloping cavalry horse. So if things go bad, the only thing to do is to lower your lance, close your eyes and pray to the gods.
70050.EnhancedInfo: Choose an ally with Armor, that unit then Duels chosen enemy.

70054.Name: Feign Death
70054.Info: Resurrect 2 Bronze Soldier units with 5 Power or more, then deal 4 Damage to each of them.
70054.Flavor: In order to set a trap, you should usually hide. But… there are exceptions to this rule.
70054.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Resurrect</color> 2 Bronze Soldier units with 5 <color=mycolor>Power</color> or more, then deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to each of them.

70058.Name: Cave Troll
70058.Info: Deploy: Boost self by 4, then Boost an enemy by 4.
70058.Flavor: Trolls have very tiny brains and huge stomachs. That's a very dangerous combination.
70058.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 4, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> an enemy by 4.

70059.Name: One-Eyed Betsy
70059.Info: Every turn, on turn start, Boost self by 3, then Boost the Highest enemy by 3.
70059.Flavor: Maybe she lacks depth perception, but she sure packs a wallop.
70059.EnhancedInfo: Every turn, on turn start, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3, then <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the Highest enemy by 3.

70062.Name: Living Armor
70062.Info: Units in the same row as this unit take at most 5 Damage at once.
70062.Flavor: Sure it's expensive. But considering how much you'll save on room and board, you'll get a return on the investment by the end of this century!
70062.EnhancedInfo: Units in the same row as this unit take at most 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> at once.

70070.Name: Highwaymen
70070.Info:
Single-Use: If there are only Bronze cards in your starting deck, Spawn a Strays of Spalla, then add 2 Strays of Spalla to your deck.
(Strays of Spalla; 5 Strength; Single-Use: Deploy: Look at 2 different random Bronze units in your deck, then play one)
70070.Flavor: We'll torture the merchant and sell the horses.
70070.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>: If there are only Bronze cards in your starting deck, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Strays of Spalla, then add 2 Strays of Spalla to your deck.
(Strays of Spalla; 5 Strength; <color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 different random Bronze units in your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> one)

70071.Name: Strays of Spalla
70071.Info:
Single-Use.
Deploy: Look at 2 diferent random Bronze units in your deck, then play one.
70071.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Look at 2 diferent random Bronze units in your deck, then <color=mycolor>play</color> one.

70072.Name: Radeyah
70072.Info: Deploy: Deal Damage equal to the number of Neutral cards in your hand 2 times.
70072.Flavor: You can hide a lot behind a beautiful smile.
70072.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> equal to the number of Neutral cards in your hand 2 times.

70076.Name: Congregation Cleric
70076.Info:
Deploy: Add on its row a 2 base Strenght copy of each Locked Bronze unit on the board.
Whenever any Bronze unit is Locked during your turn, add a 2 base Strength copy of it in the same row as this unit.
70076.Flavor: Our church is not this temple, not our scripture. It is our people, our community, we who have faith.
70076.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Add on its row a 2 base Strenght copy of each Locked Bronze unit on the board.
Whenever any Bronze unit is Locked during your turn, add a 2 base Strength copy of it in the same row as this unit.

70077.Name: Firesworn Zealot
70077.Info:
Every 4 turns, on turn end, deal 2 Damage to 4 random enemies.
Reduce the first countdown by 1 for each Locked unit on the board when played.
70077.Flavor: Great is my faith, and great is my ire!
70077.EnhancedInfo:
Every 4 turns, on turn end, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to 4 random enemies.
Reduce the first countdown by 1 for each Locked unit on the board when played.

70078.Name: Damnation
70078.Info: Summon 2 Highest Bronze units from the deck to the same row, then change their Lock status.
70078.Flavor: I can't bloody breathe! Won't they burn the wretches someplace else?
70078.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> 2 Highest Bronze units from the deck to the same row, then change their <color=mycolor>Lock</color> status.

70079.Name: An Craite Warlord
70079.Info: While in hand, deck or on the board, Boost by 1 every time you Discard a card.
70079.Flavor: Cabbage, really? It’s just the worst when there’s nothing good to plunder.
70079.EnhancedInfo: While in hand, deck or on the board, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> by 1 every time you <color=mycolor>Discard</color> a card.

70080.Name: Knut the Callous
70080.Info: Deploy: Play a Bronze unit with the highest base Strength from your deck, then deal Damage to that unit equal to half of it's Strength.
70080.Flavor: Knut, son of Oluf? Aye, never has a jarl's moniker fit so well.
70080.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze unit with the highest base Strength from your deck, then deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to that unit equal to half of it's Strength.

70081.Name: Drummond Pillager
70081.Info: When discarded, strengthen all drummond units in hand, or in the deck by 1.
70081.EnhancedInfo: When discarded, <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> all drummond units in hand, or in the deck by 1.

70082.Name: Arnjolf the Patricide
70082.Info: Deploy: Destroy all units with Strength 2 or less on both sides.
70082.Flavor: Only death can cleanse me o' shame.
70082.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy all units with Strength 2 or less on both sides.

70083.Name: Red Rider
70083.Info: Summon a copy of this unit on a random row whenever an enemy unit that is under Biting Frost is destroyed.
70083.Flavor: They paint the sky with snow and the earth with fire.
70083.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit on a random row whenever an enemy unit that is under Biting Frost is destroyed.

70084.Name: Olgierd Immortal
70084.Info: Deathwish: On turn end, resurrect this unit on the same location.
70084.EnhancedInfo: Deathwish: On turn end, <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> this unit on the same location.

70085.Name: The Apiarian Phantom
70085.Info: Deploy: Damage an ennemy unit by 7. If destroyed, apply Biting Frost on that row.
70085.Flavor: Who's a good boy? Well, surely not him.
70085.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an ennemy unit by 7. If destroyed, apply Biting Frost on that row.

70086.Name: Philippa: Mistress of the Lodge
70086.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Play a bronze or silver mage from your deck; or spawn a bronze spell.
70086.Flavor: Soon the power of kings will wither, and the Lodge shall seize its rightful place.
70086.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a bronze or silver mage from your deck; or <color=mycolor>spawn</color> a bronze spell.

70088.Name: The Thing In The Swamp
70088.Info: Deploy: Move any number of foglets in your graveyard to your deck and apply fog to the opposing row.
70088.Flavor: Fool's fires... those little shiny thingies that shall lead thee to certain doom.
70088.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Move any number of foglets in your graveyard to your deck and apply fog to the opposing row.

70089.Name: Artis
70089.Info:
Deploy: Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If the target is destroyed, spawn a Cultist Oblation to the opposite row.
Cultist Oblation (After 2 turn, on the turn starts, banish itself. Deathwish: Heal a random unit in the opponent's half of the field with the most injuries and strengthen it by 1)
70089.Flavor: Not all Svalblod priests were forced from the isles... Unfortunately.
70089.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 7 <color=mycolor>damage</color> to an enemy. If the target is destroyed, <color=mycolor>spawn</color> a Cultist Oblation to the opposite row.
Cultist Oblation (After 2 turn, on the turn starts, <color=mycolor>banish</color> itself. Deathwish: Heal a random unit in the opponent's half of the field with the most injuries and <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> it by 1)

70090.Name: Cultist Oblation
70090.Info: After 2 turn, on the turn starts, bannish itself. Deathwish: Heal a random unit in the opponent's half of the field with the most injuries and strengthen it by 1.
70090.Flavor: They... They's butcherin' folk, Captain! S-sacrifices to a bear god or some such!
70090.EnhancedInfo: After 2 turn, on the turn starts, bannish itself. Deathwish: Heal a random unit in the opponent's half of the field with the most injuries and <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> it by 1.

70091.Name: Magic Lamp
70091.Info: At the start of the game, add three copies of The Last Wish to your deck and discard self. While this card is in a graveyard, Last Wish looks at 3 cards instead of 2.
70091.Flavor: It's a little tarnished. A little rubbing will make it shiny again.
70091.EnhancedInfo: At the start of the game, add three copies of The Last Wish to your deck and <color=mycolor>discard</color> self. While this card is in a graveyard, Last Wish looks at 3 cards instead of 2.

70092.Name: Svalblod Brawler
70092.Info: Deploy: damage an enemy by twice the number of Torrential Rains on the board.
70092.Flavor: Skellige's no home to murderers and rogues... Their crimes must be repaid in blood.
70092.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>damage</color> an enemy by twice the number of Torrential Rains on the board.

70093.Name: Tempest
70093.Info: Choose 4 rows, Spawn Torrential Rain on them. If it's already under Torrential Rain, Spawn Skellige Storm on this row instead.
70093.Flavor: A Category 10 on the Bekker scale.
70093.EnhancedInfo: Choose 4 rows, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Torrential Rain on them. If it's already under Torrential Rain, <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> Skellige Storm on this row instead.

70094.Name: Lyrian Cavalry
70094.Info: Deploy: choose a unit from your deck and boost self by the amount that unit is boosted.
70094.Flavor: A horseman's worth no less than his steed. And Lyrian horses are among the Continent's best.
70094.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: choose a unit from your deck and <color=mycolor>boost</color> self by the amount that unit is boosted.

70095.Name: Lyrian Arbalest
70095.Info: Deploy: Damage an Enemy unit with lower Power than self, by the difference between the two card's Power.
70095.Flavor: I can find the bull's-eye from a hundred paces! Perhaps not with my first shot, mind you...
70095.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an Enemy unit with lower <color=mycolor>Power</color> than self, by the difference between the two card's <color=mycolor>Power</color>.

70096.Name: Tuirseach Warship
70096.Info: On turn end, deal 2 Damage to a random undamaged unit.
70096.Flavor: The rocky Skellige lands, battered by cold winds, give life only to nettles and moss. But the islanders know that there is fertile soil on the other side of the sea…
70096.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, deal 2 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random undamaged unit.

70097.Name: Dwarf Miner
70097.Info: Deploy: Strengthen self by 1 for every Dwarf in your hand.
70097.Flavor: Which moron's whistling in the mine?!
70097.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by 1 for every Dwarf in your hand.

70098.Name: Vrihedd Saboteur
70098.Info: Choose one: Play a random Bronze item; or play a Bronze Scoia'tael item.
70098.Flavor: The gates were ordered to be closed… But they didn't budge.
70098.EnhancedInfo: Choose one: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a random Bronze item; or <color=mycolor>play</color> a Bronze Scoia'tael item.

70099.Name: Svalblod
70099.Info: Damage all loyal units in your hand and deck by 2, then Strengthen them by 2. Move any cards with 2 power or lower from your deck to your graveyard. If it was in your hand, damage it to 1 instead
70099.Flavor: He proclaimed to his worshippers but one commandment: Kill.
70099.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all <color=mycolor>loyal</color> units in your hand and deck by 2, then <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> them by 2. Move any cards with 2 <color=mycolor>power</color> or lower from your deck to your graveyard. If it was in your hand, <color=mycolor>damage</color> it to 1 instead

70100.Name: Forest Whisperer
70100.Info: Deploy: Damage all units on the same row on both sides by 2, except for Dryads.
70100.Flavor: The dryads of Brokilon mastered a unique craft – to shape trees at will... And breathe into them life.
70100.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> all units on the same row on both sides by 2, except for Dryads.

70101.Name: Immortal Cavalry
70101.Info:
Single-Use.
At the start of the game, lock self. Next time an ally appears Boost it by 3.
70101.Flavor: Maybe camels aren't as swift as horses… but at least they don't die after two days in the desert.
70101.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Single-Use</color>.
At the start of the game, <color=mycolor>lock</color> self. Next time an ally appears <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 3.

70102.Name: Detlaff: Crimson Curse
70102.Info: Deploy: Banish 3 Beast or Vampire from your graveyard, then Choose One: Apply  Full Moon on all enemy rows; or apply Blood Moon on all friendly rows.
70102.Flavor: He did not love like a man, but like an animal. Madly, deeply, unconditionally. Wildly.
70102.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Banish</color> 3 Beast or Vampire from your graveyard, then <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Apply  Full Moon on all enemy rows; or apply Blood Moon on all friendly rows.

70103.Name: Artorius Vigo
70103.Info: Deploy: Select a revealed card, then tranform it to a Bronze unit from your starting deck, then Reveal it.
70103.Flavor: It is said he created an illusion so realistic that he began to believe it himself...
70103.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Select a revealed card, then tranform it to a Bronze unit from your starting deck, then <color=mycolor>Reveal</color> it.

70104.Name: Lyrian Landsknecht
70104.Info: On round end, if this card is Boosted, shuffle it back to the deck and keep at most 10 Boost.
70104.Flavor: Best not laugh at their silly-arse hats. Believe me.
70104.EnhancedInfo: On round end, if this card is Boosted, shuffle it back to the deck and keep at most 10 <color=mycolor>Boost</color>.

70105.Name: Freixenet And Braine
70105.Info: Deploy: Make a unit's Strength equal to this card's Strength.
70105.Flavor: He was only meant to be a breeding stud to her. But in the end, they fell in love regardless.
70105.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Make a unit's Strength equal to this card's Strength.

70106.Name: Endrega Eggs
70106.Info:
Deploy: Spawn 1 base copy of this card on its left.
Deathwish: Spawn an Endrega Larva on the same position.
After 3 turns, on turn end, destroy self.
(5 Strength; After 3 turns, on turn end, transform into an Endrega Warrior)
(Endrega Warrior; 7 Strength)
70106.Flavor: If you find some it's best to burn the entire forest down. Then run as far away as you can.
70106.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 1 base copy of this card on its left.
Deathwish: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> an Endrega Larva on the same position.
After 3 turns, on turn end, destroy self.
(5 Strength; After 3 turns, on turn end, <color=mycolor>transform</color> into an Endrega Warrior)
(Endrega Warrior; 7 Strength)

70107.Name: Endrega Larva
70107.Info: After 3 turns, on turn end, transform into an Endrega Warrior.
70107.EnhancedInfo: After 3 turns, on turn end, <color=mycolor>transform</color> into an Endrega Warrior.

70109.Name: Dwarven Chariot
70109.Info:
Deploy: Choose 2 units and move them to this unit's row.
When this unit is moved, Boost a random unit in the same row as this unit by 2.
70109.Flavor: You can draw anything you like, my dear dwarves. But you can't build it, mark my words.
70109.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose 2 units and move them to this unit's row.
When this unit is moved, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random unit in the same row as this unit by 2.

70110.Name: Knickers
70110.Info: On round end if this unit's Strength is higher than the number of cards in your hand, Summon this unit from your deck.
70110.Flavor: Leave it alone, Knickers! Damn it, leave it alone!
70110.EnhancedInfo: On round end if this unit's Strength is higher than the number of cards in your hand, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> this unit from your deck.

70111.Name: Palmerin de Launfal
70111.Info: Deploy: Boost a Bronze Soldier in your deck and all copies of it in hand, deck and on the board by 2, then play that unit.
70111.Flavor: Rumor had it the esteemed baron Palmerin de Launfal had fallen into a profane affair with a succubus. The duchess, however, gave no credence to such baseless hearsay.
70111.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a Bronze Soldier in your deck and all copies of it in hand, deck and on the board by 2, then <color=mycolor>play</color> that unit.

70112.Name: Primal Savagery
70112.Info: Deal 4 Damage to an ally, then choose and play one of two Bronze Cultist card from your deck, then strengthen the unit played by 1.
70112.Flavor: Not all of Svalblod's worshippers wield bow and blade. They've simply no need.
70112.EnhancedInfo: Deal 4 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an ally, then choose and <color=mycolor>play</color> one of two Bronze Cultist card from your deck, then <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> the unit played by 1.

70113.Name: Keltullis
70113.Info:
Every turn, on turn end, destroy the lowest unit if its Strength is 5 or lower.
2 Armor.
70113.Flavor: When she took roost here, they fought 'er for near a century. Then the dragon got weary o' fightin' and they realized she weren't goin' nowheres, so… they cut a deal. She dinnae bother 'em, they give 'er what she needs.
70113.EnhancedInfo:
Every turn, on turn end, destroy the lowest unit if its Strength is 5 or lower.
2 Armor.

70114.Name: Dryad Sharpshooter
70114.Info: Deploy: Destroy an enemy that has the same or lower base Strength as this unit.
70114.Flavor: She does no warning shot, always aims to kill. No mercy, even for the little ones.
70114.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy an enemy that has the same or lower base Strength as this unit.

70115.Name: Amnesty
70115.Info: Return a Bronze or Silver enemy to opponent's hand and set its power to 1.
70115.Flavor: You did what to who? To be fair, I can’t even recall the specifics anymore.
70115.EnhancedInfo: Return a Bronze or Silver enemy to opponent's hand and set its <color=mycolor>power</color> to 1.

70116.Name: Deafening Siren
70116.Info: Whenever you apply Torrential Rain to an enemy row, summon from the graveyard on a random row.
70116.Flavor: Easy, mates! Sirens never attack when... Huh? What d'yous mean Right above me?
70116.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you apply Torrential Rain to an enemy row, <color=mycolor>summon</color> from the graveyard on a random row.

70117.Name: Fauve
70117.Info: Summon this unit whenever you play the Leader. On turn end, boost all allies with the same power as self by 1.
70117.Flavor: At the edge of the wood, a lone dryad awaited them. Dandelion recognized her at once – the very same with green hair who had given them light in dark of night and urged the bard to continue his ballads.
70117.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Summon</color> this unit whenever you <color=mycolor>play</color> the Leader. On turn end, <color=mycolor>boost</color> all allies with the same <color=mycolor>power</color> as self by 1.

70118.Name: Lyrian Scytheman
70118.Info: Deploy: Boost a Bronze unit in your deck by 2.
70118.Flavor: Our folk they feed, and our foes they bleed.
70118.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a Bronze unit in your deck by 2.

70119.Name: Thaw
70119.Info:
Boost a random ally by 2.
Repeat once, then repeat this ability for each card you have played this turn.
70119.Flavor: It heralds the coming of spring... Which, in turn, heralds the coming of war.
70119.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random ally by 2.
Repeat once, then repeat this ability for each card you have played this turn.

70121.Name: Otkell
70121.Info: Increase the Damage dealt by Torrential rain on the opposite side by 1.
70121.Flavor: In his hour of doom, All-mother Freya appeared to Otkell on his ship, and gave him the means to soothe the raging tempest, for she already knew that Otkell, like his brothers, had a greater tale to tell.
70121.EnhancedInfo: Increase the <color=mycolor>Damage</color> dealt by Torrential rain on the opposite side by 1.

70122.Name: Dryad Matron
70122.Info: Deploy: Boost a random unit with the lowest power in your deck by 2. If it is a Dyad, Strenthen it instead.
70122.Flavor: She teaches young dryads many useful skills: fletching arrows, communing with the forest, slitting the throats of men...
70122.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random unit with the lowest <color=mycolor>power</color> in your deck by 2. If it is a Dyad, Strenthen it instead.

70123.Name: Battle Preparation
70123.Info: Play a Bronze soldier unit from your hand and Boost it by 2, then draw a card.
70123.Flavor: Many a knight met an untimely death because of his shoddily tied breastplate coming undone.
70123.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze soldier unit from your hand and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2, then <color=mycolor>draw</color> a card.

70124.Name: Woodland Prowlers
70124.Info: Deploy: Weaken a enemy by 1. If it's under Impenetrable Fog, Weaken by 3.
70124.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Weaken a enemy by 1. If it's under Impenetrable Fog, Weaken by 3.

70125.Name: Barnabas Beckenbauer
70125.Info: Deploy: Boost another ally unit by 2, for each unique bronze item in your graveyard
70125.Flavor: Arrived here with his peddler's wagon full o' tricks an' gadgets. Went from house tae house, praised his rubbish tae the high heavens. An' what's it he sold us? Bombs that go off in yer hand! Beard-growth formula that makes yer hair catch fire!
70125.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> another ally unit by 2, for each unique bronze item in your graveyard

70126.Name: Cintrian Royal Guard
70126.Info: Deploy: Boost self by 3. If your total power is less then the opponent, Boost the adjacent units by 3 each instead.
70126.Flavor: Queen Calanthe handpicked her personal guard with meticulous care. Each must serve with unconditional loyalty, stand more than six feet tall, and possess a devilishly handsome jawline.
70126.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> self by 3. If your total <color=mycolor>power</color> is less then the opponent, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> the adjacent units by 3 each instead.

70127.Name: Van Moorlehem Servant
70127.Flavor: They say she's served the Moorlehems for thirty years. And she hasn't aged a day…

70128.Name: Moon Dust
70128.Info: Deal 5 Damage, then deal 1 Damage to random enemy 4 times.
70128.Flavor: The werewolf lifted and tilted his head, mystified by the silvery dust... Then howled in utter agony.
70128.EnhancedInfo: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>, then deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to random enemy 4 times.

70129.Name: Natural Selection
70129.Info:
Spawn 2 Arachas Hatchlings on a row. For each copy of this card in your graveyard, spawn an extra one.
(Arachas Hatchling; 3 Strength; Summon all Arachas Drones on this row)
70129.Flavor: The strongest will survive. So not you.
70129.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 2 Arachas Hatchlings on a row. For each copy of this card in your graveyard, <color=mycolor>spawn</color> an extra one.
(Arachas Hatchling; 3 Strength; <color=mycolor>Summon</color> all Arachas Drones on this row)

70130.Name: Mantlet
70130.Info: When the unit on the right takes Damage, if this unit has armor, Damage this unit until it has no more armor instead then transfer the excess damage to the unit on the right. Crewed: Gain 6 armor.
70130.Flavor: Something like the bastard child of a shield and a palisade.
70130.EnhancedInfo: When the unit on the right takes <color=mycolor>Damage</color>, if this unit has armor, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> this unit until it has no more armor instead then transfer the excess <color=mycolor>damage</color> to the unit on the right. Crewed: Gain 6 armor.

70131.Name: Count Caldwell
70131.Info: Deploy: Swap the Strength of 2 enemy units.
70131.Flavor: Your Majesty… For the queen to question commoners, why, it's simply not proper…

70132.Name: Garkain
70132.Info: Deploy: Deal 1 Damage to a random enemy 5 times. If an enemy was already Damaged, Drain it instead.
70132.Flavor: Blood on the ceiling, entrails on the wall... Got garkain written all over it.
70132.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 1 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy 5 times. If an enemy was already Damaged, Drain it instead.

70133.Name: Lonely Champion
70133.Info: Every turn, on turn end, if no other units on your side of the board, boost self by 4.
70133.Flavor: So long as he continues the righteous fight, the Order and its flame endure.
70133.EnhancedInfo: Every turn, on turn end, if no other units on your side of the board, <color=mycolor>boost</color> self by 4.

70134.Name: Crow Clan Druid
70134.Info:
On turn end, if there is no Crow on this row, spawn a Crow on the right side.
(Crow; 2 Strength. Deathwish: Deal 3 Damage to a random enemy)
70134.Flavor: Wise men claim that animals are mindless automatons. Wise men don't know what they're talking about.
70134.EnhancedInfo:
On turn end, if there is no Crow on this row, <color=mycolor>spawn</color> a Crow on the right side.
(Crow; 2 Strength. Deathwish: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy)

70135.Name: Svalblod Priest
70135.Info: When damaged by allies, deal same amount of Damage to a unit.
70135.Flavor: The cruelty of Svalblod priests proved so fierce, so merciless that – upon the cult's collapse – they were condemned and cast out to the high seas aboard longships with nary a paddle nor sail to guide them.
70135.EnhancedInfo: When damaged by allies, deal same amount of <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a unit.

70136.Name: Crow
70136.Info: Deathwish: Deal 3 Damage to a random enemy.
70136.Flavor: When among crows, you must caw like they do.
70136.EnhancedInfo: Deathwish: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy.

70137.Name: The Great Oak
70137.Info: Deploy, Choose one: Weaken an enemy unit by half of its base Strength; or resurrect a Bronze Dryad and then return it to the deck.
70137.Flavor: The trees of Brokilon oft rustle amongst themselves, despairing of the ancient oak whose heart now rots with hatred.
70137.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, Choose one: Weaken an enemy unit by half of its base Strength; or <color=mycolor>resurrect</color> a Bronze Dryad and then return it to the deck.

70138.Name: Dryad's Caress
70138.Info: Play a Bronze or Silver Dryad unit from your deck, then boost it by the number of Dryad units on your side.
70138.Flavor: Shh, shh... Evelienn va maeth, elaine blath...
70138.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a Bronze or Silver Dryad unit from your deck, then <color=mycolor>boost</color> it by the number of Dryad units on your side.

70139.Name: Treant Boar
70139.Info: Deploy: Deal 3 Damage to a unit, then move units adjacent to the target to random rows. If the target is destroyed, repeat once.
70139.Flavor: Dryads wield a mystifying power to shape the forest's trees into any form they wish. So why not a giant boar?
70139.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a unit, then move units adjacent to the target to random rows. If the target is destroyed, repeat once.

70140.Name: Dryad Grovekeeper
70140.Info: Deploy: Transform a Bronze or Silver ally into a copy of this unit, keeping its base Strength. Then, boost all allies with strength lower than this unit's strength by 1.
70140.Flavor: Is it true? That flowers in Brokilon bloom seven times a year? But... How can that be?
70140.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Transform</color> a Bronze or Silver ally into a copy of this unit, keeping its base Strength. Then, <color=mycolor>boost</color> all allies with strength lower than this unit's strength by 1.

70141.Name: Queen Adalia
70141.Info: Deploy: Spawn a Bronze Cintra card. If there are only Northern Realm cards in your starting deck, add one copy of every Bronze Cintra card to your deck.
70141.Flavor: Queen Adalia of Cintra possessed the power to raise a drawbridge with a twitch of her brow. A frightening thought what she could do with a wave of her hand...
70141.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bronze Cintra card. If there are only Northern Realm cards in your starting deck, add one copy of every Bronze Cintra card to your deck.

70142.Name: Vissegerd
70142.Info: Deploy: Deal 8 Damage, then deal Damage equal to self's Boosts.
70142.Flavor: I will raise Cintra from the ashes no matter how great the cost.
70142.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 8 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>, then deal <color=mycolor>Damage</color> equal to self's Boosts.

70143.Name: Cintrian Knight
70143.Info: Whenever you play a Cintra unit, Boost it and self by 1 each.
70143.Flavor: For whom does the bell toll?
70143.EnhancedInfo: Whenever you <color=mycolor>play</color> a Cintra unit, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it and self by 1 each.

70144.Name: Cintrian Envoy
70144.Info: Deploy: Play a copy of this unit from your deck. If there is no copies, add a copy to your deck.
70144.Flavor: She thought service in the diplomatic corps would mean a quiet life behind a desk. She and her blistered feet were sorely mistaken...
70144.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Play</color> a copy of this unit from your deck. If there is no copies, add a copy to your deck.

70145.Name: Orianna
70145.Info: Deploy: Choose one enemy unit, make all Vampire units on your own side drain it by 1 each.
70145.Flavor: Lady Orianna's been a blessin' for us... She 'elps the beggarly, supports the arts – why, she even runs a home for them poor orphans!
70145.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Choose one enemy unit, make all Vampire units on your own side drain it by 1 each.

70146.Name: Gael
70146.Info: Deploy, Choose One: Deal 5 Damage to two enemy units each or Damage an enemy by 8.
70146.Flavor: A fondness for shiny trinkets is not a trait unique to magpies.
70146.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Choose One</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to two enemy units each or <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 8.

70147.Name: Plumard
70147.Info: Whenever an ally Vampire destroys a unit, Summon a copy of this unit from your deck on a random row. Whenever a different ally unit on the same row Drains, Drain the target by 1.
70147.Flavor: One alone poses no great threat. But a dozen? Gods be with you.
70147.EnhancedInfo: Whenever an ally Vampire destroys a unit, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of this unit from your deck on a random row. Whenever a different ally unit on the same row Drains, Drain the target by 1.

70148.Name: Alp
70148.Info: On turn end, If there is no units with higher strength then self on the opposite row, Drain a random unit on this row by 1.
70148.Flavor: The townsfolk, long plagued with horrific nightmares, posted a desperate plea for help... Hmm. An alp, gotta be, the witcher grumbled to himself.
70148.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, If there is no units with higher strength then self on the opposite row, Drain a random unit on this row by 1.

70149.Name: Anna Henrietta
70149.Info: Deploy: Sort the cards in your deck in ascending order by their base Strength, then play a card from the top of your deck.
70149.Flavor: As head of state, I must judge her fairly. But she is my sister, thus my heart bleeds for her…
70149.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Sort the cards in your deck in ascending order by their base Strength, then <color=mycolor>play</color> a card from the top of your deck.

70150.Name: Vincent van Moorlehem
70150.Info: Deploy: Destroy an enemy unit, boost its adjacent units by half of its Strength each.
70150.Flavor: Everyone gives the Moorlehems a wide berth. Even tax collectors.
70150.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Destroy an enemy unit, <color=mycolor>boost</color> its adjacent units by half of its Strength each.

70151.Name: Philippe van Moorlehem
70151.Info: Deploy: Damage an enemy by 3. On turn end if in hand, reveal self and trigger its deploy ability.
70151.Flavor: It's said that Vincent Van Moorlehem fears only one man. It's not Emhyr var Emreis or Geralt of Rivia - it’s his own son.
70151.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy by 3. On turn end if in hand, <color=mycolor>reveal</color> self and trigger its <color=mycolor>deploy</color> ability.

70152.Name: Van Moorlehem's Cupbearer
70152.Info: On turn end, if there is no Gold unit on the opposite side, gain 1 Boost.
70152.Flavor: My specialty? Tartar. Of what? Ah, that depends on the host's mood…
70152.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if there is no Gold unit on the opposite side, gain 1 <color=mycolor>Boost</color>.

70153.Name: Van Moorlehem Hunter
70153.Info: Deploy: Damage an enemy unit by 3. If there is no Gold card in your hand, repeat once.
70153.Flavor: Rather than beasts, he prefers to stalk poachers. But they don't come as often anymore into the woods surrounding the palace…
70153.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Damage</color> an enemy unit by 3. If there is no Gold card in your hand, repeat once.

70154.Name: Iris: Shade
70154.Info: Deploy, Truce: Add 2 Iris' Companions to both hands.
70154.Flavor: Olgierd's betrothed was like a dream…
70154.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>, <color=mycolor>Truce</color>: Add 2 Iris' Companions to both hands.

70155.Name: Isbel of Hagge
70155.Info: Deploy: Reset a unit. If it's an ally, repeat once.
70155.Flavor: I promised I would never again use magic to harm others.
70155.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Reset</color> a unit. If it's an ally, repeat once.

70156.Name: Piercing Missile
70156.Info: Deal 7 Damage to an enemy unit ignoring Armour. If this unit is Boosted, Damage it by 10 instead.
70156.Flavor: There's no armor that can't be pierced.
70156.EnhancedInfo: Deal 7 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to an enemy unit ignoring Armour. If this unit is Boosted, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> it by 10 instead.

70157.Name: Wisteria
70157.Info: Choose two units, for each, Boost it by 6 if the unit's Power is even, Damage it by 6 if the unit's Power is odd.
70157.Flavor: Those who want to destroy Brokilon, who try to burn its trees and kill all the living things in it, will soon enough become nourishment for its soil.
70157.EnhancedInfo: Choose two units, for each, <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 6 if the unit's <color=mycolor>Power</color> is even, <color=mycolor>Damage</color> it by 6 if the unit's <color=mycolor>Power</color> is odd.

70158.Name: Coën of Poviss
70158.Info: Deploy: Deal 5 Damage. If the target is destroyed, Reduce the damage by 1 and repeat this ability.
70158.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: Deal 5 <color=mycolor>Damage</color>. If the target is destroyed, Reduce the <color=mycolor>damage</color> by 1 and repeat this ability.

70159.Name: Crowmother
70159.Info:
Deploy: Discard up to 3 Bronze Special cards from your deck. While this card is on the board, spawn a Crow for each special card discarded.
(Crow; 2 Strength. Deathwish: Deal 3 Damage to a random enemy)
70159.Flavor: Some crows learn human words. And some humans learn the language of the crows.
70159.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Discard</color> up to 3 Bronze Special cards from your deck. While this card is on the board, <color=mycolor>spawn</color> a Crow for each special card discarded.
(Crow; 2 Strength. Deathwish: Deal 3 <color=mycolor>Damage</color> to a random enemy)

70160.Name: Vildkaarl
70160.Info: Deploy: Deal 4 Damage to adjacent units.
70160.Flavor: Strike me! C'mon, harder! You call this pain?!

70161.Name: Azar Javed
70161.Info:
Deploy: Spawn 2 Scarabs.
(Scarab: 1 Strength. If spying move to oposite row after you pass.)
70161.Flavor: Azar Javed's specialty is the element of fire. The sorcerer not only deftly manipulates the power of fire, it can be said that fire has become a part of his very being.
70161.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> 2 Scarabs.
(Scarab: 1 Strength. If <color=mycolor>spying</color> move to oposite row after you pass.)

70162.Name: Scarab
70162.Info: If spying move to oposite row after you pass.
70162.Flavor: In Zerrikania, they’re considered a symbol of resurrection. But to be born again, first you have to die.
70162.EnhancedInfo: If <color=mycolor>spying</color> move to oposite row after you pass.

70163.Name: Reynard Odo
70163.Info: On turn end, if it has at least 3 Boosts, Reset self and Boost all allies on the same row by 1.
70163.Flavor: Under your husband I served ten years, under you another eight. And never in that time did I fight for a more worthy cause.
70163.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if it has at least 3 Boosts, <color=mycolor>Reset</color> self and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> all allies on the same row by 1.

70164.Name: Tatterwing
70164.Info: On turn end, move all units on the opposite row to random rows, then deal 1 damage to each of them.
70164.Flavor: She seems a bit sluggish. A few quick jabs to the ribs oughta liven her up.
70164.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, move all units on the opposite row to random rows, then deal 1 <color=mycolor>damage</color> to each of them.

70165.Name: Vivienne de Tabris
70165.Info: Deploy: Transform an ally unit into a different Gold unit from your starting deck, and Boost it by 2.
70165.Flavor: Vivienne's a bit of an odd duck for a lady-in-waitin'. But by the Gods, ye can't deny her beauty an' grace!
70165.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: <color=mycolor>Transform</color> an ally unit into a different Gold unit from your starting deck, and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> it by 2.

70166.Name: Cursed Scroll
70166.Info: Look at 3 random cards with different colors from your deck. Play one, discard the other two.
70166.Flavor: The seal states clearly: do not open. But of course… curiosity will win out.
70166.EnhancedInfo: Look at 3 random cards with different colors from your deck. <color=mycolor>Play</color> one, <color=mycolor>discard</color> the other two.

70167.Name: Zoltans Company
70167.Info: Put back up to 3 non-gold dwarves in your deck then play a non-gold dwarf from your deck. When this card is in the graveyard, give 1 armor to each dwarf you play.
70167.Flavor: They'd follow each other into the fire. And laugh about it.
70167.EnhancedInfo: Put back up to 3 non-gold dwarves in your deck then <color=mycolor>play</color> a non-gold dwarf from your deck. When this card is in the graveyard, give 1 armor to each dwarf you <color=mycolor>play</color>.

70168.Name: Ogre Warrior
70168.Info: On turn end, damage self by half if you don't have the highest unit.
70168.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, <color=mycolor>damage</color> self by half if you don't have the highest unit.

70169.Name: Nekker Swarm
70169.Info: On turn end, if no ennemy is stronger than the strongest ogroid ally, reduce the counter of the last copy of this unit by 1. When it reaches 0 summon self on a random row and Boost a random ally by 1.
70169.EnhancedInfo: On turn end, if no ennemy is stronger than the strongest ogroid ally, reduce the counter of the last copy of this unit by 1. When it reaches 0 <color=mycolor>summon</color> self on a random row and <color=mycolor>Boost</color> a random ally by 1.

70170.Name: Cloud Giant
70170.Info:
Deploy: If you control the highest unit, gain Immunity. If you don't, loose Immunity. On turn start repeat Deploy ability.
Resilient
70170.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Deploy</color>: If you control the highest unit, gain <color=mycolor>Immunity</color>. If you don't, loose <color=mycolor>Immunity</color>. On turn start repeat <color=mycolor>Deploy</color> ability.
Resilient

70171.Name: Giant's Belt
70171.Info: Boost an ally by its base Power, if it is an Ogroid, strengthen it by 2 before.
70171.Flavor: A sturdy leather belt, clearly crafted for a titan, yet inexplicably fits the torso of anyone who tries it on. Although the girdle makes its wearer as strong as a giant, it does not make them giant-size.
70171.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Boost</color> an ally by its base <color=mycolor>Power</color>, if it is an Ogroid, <color=mycolor>strengthen</color> it by 2 before.

70172.Name: Princess
70172.Info: Spawn a Bear. If there is a Witcher on this row, spawn a Raging Bear instead.
70172.Flavor: You've got all that important qualities every Roach has to have - you don't talk much.
70172.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> a Bear. If there is a Witcher on this row, <color=mycolor>spawn</color> a Raging Bear instead.

70173.Name: Deadeye Ambush
70173.Info: Select an ally, boost it by 5 and move it to the row below, select an enemy, damage it by 5 and move it to the melee row.
70173.Flavor: One, two, come into view; Three, four, hide 'hind the door; Five, six, this'll be quick; Seven, eight, come meet your fate!
70173.EnhancedInfo: Select an ally, <color=mycolor>boost</color> it by 5 and move it to the row below, select an enemy, <color=mycolor>damage</color> it by 5 and move it to the melee row.

70174.Name: Mage Infiltrator
70174.Info:
Spying.
Reveal two enemy cards, then Spawn and Play a copy of a different bronze card in your opponent's hand.
70174.Flavor: In her spare time, she likes playing practical jokes on others. Her favorite gag is switching footwraps and headwear.
70174.EnhancedInfo:
<color=mycolor>Spying</color>.
<color=mycolor>Reveal</color> two enemy cards, then <color=mycolor>Spawn</color> and <color=mycolor>Play</color> a copy of a different bronze card in your opponent's hand.

70175.Name: Trapmaker
70175.Info: When an allied ambush is activated, Summon a copy of self on the same row.
70175.Flavor: Always the same with these people: Ahhh, I can't feel my legs! You'd think they'd at least appreciate the craftsmanship...
70175.EnhancedInfo: When an allied <color=mycolor>ambush</color> is activated, <color=mycolor>Summon</color> a copy of self on the same row.

80001.Name: Auberon: King
80001.Flavor: The end of one world can be the beginning of another.

80002.Name: Auberon: Invader
80002.Info: He will awaken the Wild Hunt.
80002.Flavor: If they will not submit, they shall be driven out!
80002.EnhancedInfo: He will awaken the Wild Hunt.

80003.Name: Auberon: Conqueror
80003.Flavor: After having lived over six hundred and fifty years, little remains to excite.

89004.Name: Gascon: Iron Falcon
89004.Info: Charm the Highest enemy on the opposite. Can't be affected by status effects, Booat Deck by point.
89004.Flavor: I'm doing what I used to do and they're paying me for it!
89004.EnhancedInfo: <color=mycolor>Charm</color> the Highest enemy on the opposite. Can't be affected by status effects, Booat Deck by point.

89005.Name: Iron Falcon Infantry
89005.Info: If there is boost, double the boost.
89005.Flavor: You have to look good on the battlefield too.

89006.Name: Iron Falcon Troubadour
89006.Info: Randomly give 1 point of gain to 1 allied unit, repeat 4 times,  and repeat an additional 4 times for each card of the same name on the field.
89006.Flavor: When I play even dying's more pleasant.
89006.EnhancedInfo: Randomly give 1 point of gain to 1 allied unit, repeat 4 times,  and repeat an additional 4 times for each card of the same name on the field.

89007.Name: Iron Falcon Knife Juggler
89007.Info: Generate a copy of oneself with the same power, and give 1 point of gain to cards with the same name on the field.
89007.Flavor: The weapon's short, but its range is long.
89007.EnhancedInfo: Generate a copy of oneself with the same <color=mycolor>power</color>, and give 1 point of gain to cards with the same name on the field.

89008.Name: Fresh Recruit
89008.Info: At the start of the game, Strengthen self by The Goddess of Justice's Power.
89008.EnhancedInfo: At the start of the game, <color=mycolor>Strengthen</color> self by The Goddess of Justice's <color=mycolor>Power</color>.
